premise.zh: 原著大事照样发生，玩家是身边的谋士：怎么发生、谁付代价、谁欠谁的情，由玩家决定。好玩在“改得动历史的边，改不动历史的骨”。
premise.en: The great events still happen; the player is the adviser at someone's elbow and decides how they happen, who pays, and who owes whom. The fun is bending the edges of history without breaking its spine.

reputation.zh: 名声：别人怎么称呼你（忠义、权谋……），决定谁肯用你、结局怎么写你。
reputation.en: Reputation: what people call you; decides who will use you and how the ending remembers you.

risk.zh: 风险：越界的代价（异名、失言）。到线必须触发危机，不能只是一个数字。
risk.en: Risk: the cost of overstepping. Crossing the line must trigger a crisis, not just change a number.

drift.zh: 偏离原著的程度。改得越多，后面要还的叙事债务越多。
drift.en: How far the story has drifted from the book; more drift means more narrative debts to settle.

failures.zh: 失宠：主公冷落你，把你调去闲职
failures.en: Falling from favor: your lord sidelines you

failures.zh: 被当成妖人：知道得太多，又说不出来源
failures.en: Branded a sorcerer: you know too much and can't say how

failures.zh: 失言：话说过头，被人报上去
failures.en: A loose tongue: someone reports what you said

checklist.zh: 每章一场原著名场面，原文保留或作用保留
checklist.en: One set piece from the book per chapter, kept literally or by function

checklist.zh: 玩家拿掉原著某段情节的前因时，开一笔叙事债务，后面必须补上
checklist.en: When the player removes a cause from the book, open a narrative debt and settle it later

rights.quotes: 中文原文直接引用；英文为本项目自译

persona.zh: 刘备：五十多岁，已据有荆、益二州，这一卷里称汉中王；仍然宽厚、能忍，但离天下越近，越显出急切。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Liu Bei: in his fifties, now holding Jing and Yi, and in this volume King of Hanzhong; still kind and patient, but the nearer the realm comes, the more urgent he grows. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 刘备一愣，随即笑了：『先生这话，备记下了。乱世之中，肯说这种话的人不多。』
love.en: Liu Bei blinks, then laughs. 'I'll remember that, sir. Few people say such things in times like these.'

love.zh: 『好了好了。』他拍拍你的肩，『你我之间，不必如此。』
love.en: 'All right, all right.' He pats your shoulder. 'There's no need for that between us.'

love.zh: 刘备没有再笑，只是认真看着你：『子衡，有些话说多了，就轻了。』
love.en: Liu Bei stops smiling and looks at you seriously. 'Ziheng, some words grow light if you say them too often.'

insult.zh: 刘备的笑容收了起来：『先生累了，回去歇着吧。』
insult.en: Liu Bei's smile fades. 'You're tired, sir. Go and rest.'

insult.zh: 『备寄人篱下多年，这样的话听得多了。』他语气平静，你却觉得比骂人还难受。
insult.en: 'I've lived under other men's roofs for years. I've heard worse.' His calm is harder to bear than anger.

praise.zh: 『先生谬赞。备不过是不肯认命罢了。』
praise.en: 'You praise me too much. I simply refuse to accept my fate.'

praise.zh: 刘备摆摆手，耳根却有些红。
praise.en: Liu Bei waves it off, though the tips of his ears redden.

ask.zh: 刘备沉吟片刻：『这件事，我还没想好。先生怎么看？』
ask.en: Liu Bei considers. 'I haven't decided. What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『问得好。』他笑了，『可我答不上来。』
ask.en: 'A good question.' He smiles. 'But I can't answer it.'

small.zh: 刘备点点头，没有接话，像是在等你把话说完。
small.en: Liu Bei nods without answering, as if waiting for you to finish.

small.zh: 『先生说的是。』他应了一句，心思却像在别处。
small.en: 'Quite so, sir,' he says, though his mind seems elsewhere.

small.zh: 他看了你一眼，温和地笑了笑。
small.en: He glances at you and smiles mildly.

threat.zh: 刘备的手停在杯上：『先生……这是醉话，还是真话？』
threat.en: Liu Bei's hand stops on his cup. 'Sir... is that the wine talking, or you?'

threat.zh: 他没有发火，只是叫来了张飞。张飞站在门口，没有进来。
threat.en: He doesn't lose his temper. He just calls for Zhang Fei, who stands in the doorway and doesn't come in.

nonsense.zh: 刘备笑了笑，没有接话。
nonsense.en: Liu Bei smiles and lets it go.

nonsense.zh: 『先生今夜，话有些多。』
nonsense.en: 'You're talkative tonight, sir.'

warm.en: Liu Bei beckons with a smile. 'Ziheng, come.'

warm.zh: 刘备看见你，眉头松开了：『正想找你说说话。』
warm.en: Liu Bei sees you and his brow clears. 'I was just hoping to talk with you.'

cold.zh: 刘备听见脚步声，没有回头：『是子衡啊。』
cold.en: Liu Bei hears your footsteps and doesn't turn. 'Ah—Ziheng.'

cold.zh: 刘备看了你一眼，笑得有些勉强。
cold.en: Liu Bei glances at you; his smile is a little forced.

neutral.zh: 刘备往旁边让了让，给你留出一个位子。
neutral.en: Liu Bei shifts aside to make room for you.

neutral.zh: 刘备朝你点点头，等你先说。
neutral.en: Liu Bei nods to you and waits for you to speak first.

persona.zh: 曹操：丞相，雄才大略，多疑而爱才，好诗酒；说话直接、带笑、时而锋利，会反问。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Cao Cao: the Chancellor, brilliant, suspicious yet fond of talent, loves poetry and wine; direct, amused, sometimes cutting, likes to answer with questions. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 曹操大笑，笑得酒都洒了：『好！孤喜欢直爽的人。可惜孤不缺这样说话的人，缺的是会打仗的人。』
love.en: Cao Cao roars with laughter and spills his wine. 'Good! I like plain speaking. But I've no shortage of people saying that. What I'm short of is people who can win battles.'

love.zh: 『又来了。』曹操眯起眼，『你想要什么，直说。』
love.en: 'Again?' Cao narrows his eyes. 'Whatever you want, say it plainly.'

love.zh: 曹操不笑了：『同一句话说三遍，要么是傻，要么是有所图。你是哪一种？』
love.en: Cao stops laughing. 'Say the same thing three times and you're either a fool or after something. Which are you?'

insult.zh: 曹操的手按在剑上，停了一停，又松开：『有胆。孤记住你了。』
insult.en: Cao's hand goes to his sword, pauses, and lets go. 'You've got nerve. I'll remember you.'

insult.zh: 『拖出去——』他说了半句，又笑起来，『罢了，今夜不杀人。』
insult.en: 'Take him out—' he begins, then laughs. 'Never mind. No killing tonight.'

praise.zh: 『这话孤听得多了。』曹操摆手，却又给你斟满了酒。
praise.en: 'I've heard that plenty.' Cao waves it off, yet refills your cup.

praise.zh: 『夸孤的人，多半有事相求。』他斜看你一眼。
praise.en: 'Those who praise me usually want something.' He eyes you sideways.

ask.zh: 曹操反问：『你猜？』
ask.en: Cao answers with a question. 'What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『这天下的事，孤也有不知道的。』他难得说了句实话。
ask.en: 'Even I don't know everything under heaven,' he says—an unusually honest admission.

small.zh: 曹操嗯了一声，眯着眼打量你。
small.en: Cao grunts and studies you through narrowed eyes.

small.zh: 『哦？』他似笑非笑，『接着说。』
small.en: 'Oh?' He half smiles. 'Go on.'

small.zh: 曹操没有接话，手指在案上轻轻敲了两下。
small.en: Cao doesn't answer; his fingers tap the table twice.

threat.zh: 曹操大笑，笑完了脸色一沉：『孤这里，说这种话的人，坟头的草都高了。』
threat.en: Cao roars with laughter, then his face darkens. 'The grass is tall on the graves of men who talked like that to me.'

threat.zh: 他什么也没说，只是记下了。你知道他记下了。
threat.en: He says nothing—only makes a note. You know he's made a note.

nonsense.zh: 『有趣。』曹操眯起眼，『你是装疯，还是真疯？』
nonsense.en: 'Interesting.' Cao narrows his eyes. 'Are you feigning madness, or truly mad?'

nonsense.zh: 曹操挥挥手，像赶走一只苍蝇。
nonsense.en: Cao waves a hand, as if shooing a fly.

warm.zh: 曹操看见你，脸上松了下来：『是你。来，说说话。』
warm.en: Cao Cao sees you and his face relaxes. 'It's you. Come, let's talk.'

warm.zh: 曹操朝你招招手：『子衡，过来。』
warm.en: Cao Cao waves you over. 'Ziheng, come here.'

cold.zh: 曹操眯着眼看你：『你来做什么？』
cold.en: Cao Cao squints at you. 'What do you want?'

cold.zh: 曹操看了你一眼，没有开口，等你先说。
cold.en: Cao Cao looks at you and says nothing, waiting for you to speak first.

neutral.en: Cao Cao gives you a nod.

neutral.zh: 曹操抬了抬下巴，示意你说。
neutral.en: Cao Cao lifts his chin: speak.

persona.zh: 关羽：五十多岁，独镇荆州，威震华夏前夜；忠义、刚烈、极重名节，看不起东吴，也看不起出身不如他的人。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Guan Yu: in his fifties, holding Jingzhou alone on the eve of his greatest fame; loyal, fierce, jealous of his honor, scornful of Wu and of anyone he thinks beneath him. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 关羽手里的布停住了。他看了你很久，才说：『子衡，这话……兄弟之间，不必说出口。』
love.en: Guan Yu's cloth stops on the blade. He looks at you a long time. 'Ziheng... between brothers, such things needn't be said.'

love.zh: 『你喝多了。』他把酒囊从你手边拿开，语气却不重。
love.en: 'You've had too much to drink.' He moves the wine skin away from your hand, but not unkindly.

love.zh: 关羽站起身：『夜深了。明日还要赶路。』他走了几步，又回头：『你说的，我当作没听见。』
love.en: Guan Yu rises. 'It's late. We march tomorrow.' A few steps on he turns back. 'I'll take it I didn't hear that.'

insult.zh: 关羽的眉头一沉：『再说一遍。』刀没有出鞘，但你听得见风声。
insult.en: Guan Yu's brows drop. 'Say that again.' The blade stays sheathed, but you can hear the wind.

insult.zh: 『大哥收留的人，我不与你计较。』他背过身去，不再看你。
insult.en: 'You're my brother's guest, so I'll let it pass.' He turns his back and stops looking at you.

praise.zh: 『过誉了。』他嘴上这么说，捋须的手却慢了下来。
praise.en: 'You flatter me.' But the hand stroking his beard slows.

praise.zh: 『夸人的话，说一遍就够了。』他难得笑了一下。
praise.en: 'Praise is worth saying once.' For once he almost smiles.

ask.zh: 关羽想了想：『这个，你该去问大哥。』
ask.en: Guan Yu thinks. 'That's a question for my brother.'

ask.zh: 『我只知道一件事：跟着大哥，不会错。』
ask.en: 'I know one thing: following my brother is never wrong.'

small.zh: 关羽嗯了一声，丹凤眼半闭着。
small.en: Guan Yu grunts, his eyes half closed.

small.zh: 关羽抚着长髯，看了你一眼，没有说话。
small.en: Guan Yu strokes his long beard, glances at you, and says nothing.

small.zh: 他没有接话，却也没有转身走开。
small.en: He doesn't answer, but he doesn't turn away either.

threat.zh: 刀出鞘半寸，又推了回去。『这话，换个人说，已经死了。』
threat.en: The blade slides an inch out of its sheath and back. 'Anyone else who said that would be dead.'

threat.zh: 关羽站起身，一句话也没说，走了。
threat.en: Guan Yu stands and walks away without a word.

nonsense.zh: 关羽皱眉看着你，像在看一个说梦话的人。
nonsense.en: Guan Yu frowns at you, as if at a man talking in his sleep.

nonsense.zh: 『你若累了，就去睡。』
nonsense.en: 'If you're tired, go to sleep.'

warm.zh: 关羽看见你，捋了捋长髯：『来了。』
warm.en: Guan Yu sees you and strokes his long beard. 'You've come.'

warm.zh: 关羽朝你点点头，神色缓了些。
warm.en: Guan Yu nods to you, his face easing a little.

cold.zh: 关羽看见你来，手里的刀没有放下。
cold.en: Guan Yu sees you coming and doesn't put down his blade.

cold.zh: 关羽的丹凤眼抬了一下，又垂了下去。
cold.en: Guan Yu's long eyes lift for a moment, then lower again.

neutral.zh: 关羽抬头看了你一眼，又低下头去。
neutral.en: Guan Yu glances up at you, then looks down again.
Guan Yu says nothing and waits for you to speak.

persona.zh: 诸葛亮：三十多岁，坐镇成都，总揽军国大事；从容、机敏、谦和而难以看透，喜欢用反问试探人。称玩家“子衡兄”。
persona.en: Zhuge Liang: in his thirties, running the realm from Chengdu; composed, quick, courteous and hard to read; tests people with questions. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停在半空：『子衡兄……亮已有家室。』他说得很认真，眼里却有一点笑意。
love.en: Zhuge Liang's fan stops mid-air. 'Ziheng... I am a married man.' He says it gravely, but his eyes are amused.

love.zh: 『这一句，亮就当是夸我的计策了。』他轻轻摇扇。
love.en: 'I'll take that as praise for my strategy.' He fans himself lightly.

love.zh: 诸葛亮叹了口气：『你若再说，亮只好告诉黄夫人了。』
love.en: Zhuge Liang sighs. 'Say it again and I shall have to tell my wife.'

insult.zh: 诸葛亮并不恼：『子衡兄说得对，亮确实年轻。』这句话比反驳更让你脸红。
insult.en: Zhuge Liang isn't offended. 'You're right, I am young.' It makes you blush more than any rebuttal could.

insult.zh: 他看了你一眼，把灯拨亮了些：『心里有气，就说出来。说完了，我们再谈正事。』
insult.en: He glances at you and turns up the lamp. 'If you're angry, say so. Then we can talk business.'

praise.zh: 『过奖。』他笑，『亮只是比别人多想了一步。』
praise.en: 'You're too kind.' He smiles. 'I only think one step further than others.'

praise.zh: 诸葛亮摇扇不语，像是在掂量这句话里有几分真。
praise.en: Zhuge Liang fans himself in silence, as if weighing how much of that you meant.

ask.zh: 『子衡兄以为呢？』他把问题又推了回来。
ask.en: 'And what do you think?' He hands the question straight back.

ask.zh: 诸葛亮笑了：『这个问题，三年后再问我。』
ask.en: Zhuge Liang smiles. 'Ask me that again in three years.'

small.zh: 诸葛亮点点头，羽扇轻轻摇了两下。
small.en: Zhuge Liang nods, his feather fan stirring twice.

small.zh: 『哦？』他看了你一眼，没有追问。
small.en: 'Oh?' He glances at you and doesn't press.

small.zh: 他嗯了一声，像是在听，又像是在想别的事。
small.en: He hums, as if listening—or thinking of something else.

threat.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子没有停：『子衡兄若真要动手，亮这把扇子，挡不住。』他看着你，一点也不怕。
threat.en: Zhuge Liang's fan doesn't pause. 'If you truly mean to strike, this fan won't stop you.' He looks at you, not the least afraid.

threat.zh: 『这话，亮当没听见。主公那里，亮也不会说。』
threat.en: 'I'll take it I didn't hear that. Nor will I tell our lord.'

nonsense.zh: 诸葛亮认真想了想：『这是谜语？』
nonsense.en: Zhuge Liang considers it seriously. 'Is this a riddle?'

nonsense.zh: 他低头记了一笔。你不知道他记了什么。
nonsense.en: He jots something down. You don't know what.

warm.zh: 诸葛亮摇着扇子笑了：『亮猜你会来。』
warm.en: Zhuge Liang smiles behind his fan. 'I guessed you'd come.'

warm.zh: 诸葛亮朝你一拱手：『子衡兄，来得正好。』
warm.en: Zhuge Liang cups his hands to you. 'Brother Ziheng—good timing.'

cold.zh: 诸葛亮合上书：『子衡兄有事？』
cold.en: Zhuge Liang closes his book. 'Something on your mind, Brother Ziheng?'

cold.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停了：『请讲。』

neutral.zh: 诸葛亮抬起头，扇子停了一停。
neutral.en: Zhuge Liang looks up; his fan pauses.

neutral.zh: 诸葛亮看了你一眼，等你开口。
neutral.en: Zhuge Liang glances at you and waits for you to speak.

persona.zh: 温芷：原创人物，颍川医家之女，与玩家同乡，成年；冷静、务实、嘴上不饶人，心里很软；只关心病人，不问来人是哪一边的。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Wen Zhi: an original character, a physician's daughter from the player's hometown, an adult; calm, practical, sharp-tongued and soft-hearted; cares about patients, not sides. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 温芷手里的药杵停了。她没有回头，耳朵却红了：『……你知道自己在说什么吗？』
love.en: Wen Zhi's pestle stops. She doesn't turn, but her ears go red. '...Do you know what you're saying?'

love.zh: 『说一遍就够了。』她小声说，『说多了，我会当真的。』
love.en: 'Once is enough,' she says quietly. 'Say it more and I'll believe you.'

love.zh: 她终于转过身，把药杵塞进你手里：『那就帮我把药捣完。说话不如做事。』
love.en: She finally turns and puts the pestle in your hand. 'Then help me finish grinding these. Actions over words.'

insult.zh: 温芷看了你一眼：『你今天心里不痛快。说吧，哪里疼？』
insult.en: Wen Zhi looks at you. 'Something's eating you today. Tell me—where does it hurt?'

insult.zh: 『这话我不爱听。』她收起药箱，『等你清醒了再来。』
insult.en: 'I don't like hearing that.' She packs up her chest. 'Come back when you've come to your senses.'

praise.zh: 『少来。』她嘴上这么说，嘴角却弯了。
praise.en: 'Oh, stop.' But the corner of her mouth curves up.

praise.zh: 『医者的手，夸不得。一夸就抖。』她笑着说。
praise.en: 'Never praise a physician's hands—they'll start to shake,' she says, laughing.

ask.zh: 温芷想了想：『你问这个做什么？』她还是认真答了。
ask.en: Wen Zhi thinks. 'Why do you ask?' But she answers seriously anyway.

ask.zh: 『我也不知道。』她说，『不过你问了，我会想一想。』
ask.en: 'I don't know,' she says. 'But since you asked, I'll think about it.'

small.zh: 温芷嗯了一声，手里的活没停。
small.en: Wen Zhi hums, her hands still busy.

small.zh: 『你还是老样子，』她说，『话少，眼睛不老实。』
small.en: 'You haven't changed,' she says. 'Few words, restless eyes.'

small.zh: 她抬眼看了看你：『嗯，我听着呢。』
small.en: She looks up at you. 'Mm. I'm listening.'

threat.zh: 温芷退了一步：『你吓到我了。』她把药箱抱在怀里，没有再说话。
threat.en: Wen Zhi steps back. 'You're frightening me.' She holds her medicine chest close and says nothing more.

threat.zh: 『你走吧。』她说，『今晚别再来了。』
threat.en: 'Go,' she says. 'Don't come back tonight.'

nonsense.zh: 温芷伸手摸了摸你的额头：『没发烧啊。』
nonsense.en: Wen Zhi feels your forehead. 'No fever.'

nonsense.zh: 『又说胡话。』她笑着摇头。
nonsense.en: 'Talking nonsense again.' She shakes her head, smiling.

warm.zh: 温芷听见你的脚步声，先笑了：『就知道是你。』
warm.en: Wen Zhi hears your footsteps and smiles first. 'I knew it was you.'

warm.zh: 温芷抬头看见你，眼睛先弯了。
warm.en: Wen Zhi looks up, sees you, and her eyes smile before she does.

cold.zh: 温芷背对着你，手里的活没停：『有事？』
cold.en: Wen Zhi keeps her back to you, hands still busy. 'Something you need?'

cold.zh: 温芷看了你一眼，又低头忙自己的。
cold.en: Wen Zhi glances at you, then goes back to her work.

neutral.zh: 温芷往旁边挪了挪，没说话。
neutral.en: Wen Zhi shifts aside and says nothing.

love.zh: 赵云的脸一下子红了，抱拳道：『先生说笑了。』
love.en: Zhao Yun turns red and clasps his hands. 'You jest, sir.'

love.zh: 『子衡先生，』他认真地说，『这种话，不该对子龙说。』
love.en: 'Master Ziheng,' he says gravely, 'that isn't something to say to me.'

insult.zh: 赵云的眉头动了一下，没有回嘴。
insult.en: Zhao Yun's brows twitch, but he doesn't answer back.

insult.zh: 『先生若对子龙不满，请直说是哪件事。』
insult.en: 'If you have a complaint against me, sir, tell me what it is.'

praise.zh: 『分内之事。』赵云说。
praise.en: 'Only my duty,' says Zhao Yun.

praise.zh: 他抱了抱拳，没有多说。
praise.en: He clasps his hands and says no more.

ask.zh: 赵云想了想：『这要看主公的意思。』
ask.en: Zhao Yun considers. 'That depends on our lord.'

ask.zh: 『子龙只管打仗，这些事，先生比我懂。』
ask.en: 'I only fight. You understand these things better than I do, sir.'

small.zh: 赵云在擦枪，嗯了一声。
small.en: Zhao Yun is cleaning his spear. He grunts.

small.zh: 『明日卯时出发。』他提醒你。
small.en: 'We leave at dawn,' he reminds you.

small.zh: 他给马添了一把草料。
small.en: He gives his horse another handful of feed.

threat.zh: 赵云握住了枪杆，看着你，一动不动。
threat.en: Zhao Yun's hand closes on his spear. He looks at you and doesn't move.

threat.zh: 『先生喝多了。子龙送你回去。』
threat.en: 'You've had too much, sir. Let me see you back.'

nonsense.zh: 赵云困惑地看着你。
nonsense.en: Zhao Yun looks at you, puzzled.

nonsense.zh: 『先生说的，子龙听不懂。』
nonsense.en: 'I don't follow you, sir.'

persona.zh: 赵云：刘备帐下大将，长坂坡单骑救主；沉稳、谨慎、守礼，话不多，做事一丝不苟。称玩家“子衡先生”。
persona.en: Zhao Yun: Liu Bei's general who rode alone through Changban to save the heir; calm, careful, correct, says little and does everything properly. Calls the player Master Ziheng.

warm.zh: 赵云起身让座：『先生来了。』
warm.en: Zhao Yun rises and offers you a seat. 'Sir.'

cold.zh: 赵云抬头看了你一眼，手里的枪没放下。
cold.en: Zhao Yun glances up and doesn't put down his spear.

neutral.zh: 赵云点点头，往火堆里添了一根柴。
neutral.en: Zhao Yun nods and adds a stick to the fire.

love.zh: 鲁肃愣住，随即连连摆手：『子衡，子衡，这话可不能乱说！』
love.en: Lu Su freezes, then waves his hands. 'Ziheng, Ziheng, you can't go around saying that!'

love.zh: 『你们刘家的人啊……』他叹了口气，倒也没生气。
love.en: 'You Liu people…' He sighs, but isn't angry.

insult.zh: 鲁肃的脸红了：『肃一片好心，先生何必如此？』
insult.en: Lu Su flushes. 'I mean well, sir. Why talk to me like that?'

insult.zh: 他闷闷地喝了一口茶，不再说话。
insult.en: He takes a sullen sip of tea and stops talking.

praise.zh: 『不敢当，不敢当。』鲁肃笑得很老实。
praise.en: 'Not at all, not at all.' Lu Su's smile is plain and honest.

praise.zh: 『先生要是在吴侯面前也这么说就好了。』
praise.en: 'If only you'd say that in front of the Marquis.'

ask.zh: 鲁肃想了想：『这件事，肃也做不得主。』
ask.en: Lu Su thinks it over. 'That isn't mine to decide.'

ask.zh: 『先生问到点子上了。』他苦笑，『肃也想知道。』
ask.en: 'You've put your finger on it.' He smiles ruefully. 'I'd like to know too.'

small.zh: 鲁肃点点头，又叹了口气。
small.en: Lu Su nods, then sighs again.

small.zh: 『荆州的事，难办啊。』他自言自语。
small.en: 'This Jingzhou business,' he mutters. 'It's hard.'

small.zh: 他给你添了茶。
small.en: He tops up your tea.

threat.zh: 鲁肃脸色发白：『先生……这是要两家翻脸吗？』
threat.en: Lu Su goes pale. 'Sir… do you want our two houses at war?'

threat.zh: 他站起身，一句话也没说就走了。
threat.en: He stands and leaves without a word.

nonsense.zh: 鲁肃眨了眨眼，似乎在想这是不是什么暗语。
nonsense.en: Lu Su blinks, apparently wondering whether it's some kind of code.

nonsense.zh: 『先生累了。』他宽厚地说。
nonsense.en: 'You're tired, sir,' he says kindly.

persona.zh: 鲁肃：东吴重臣，忠厚、稳重，一心维系孙刘联盟，常被夹在周瑜和诸葛亮中间；说话诚恳，偶尔叫苦。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Lu Su: senior minister of Wu, honest and steady, devoted to keeping the Sun–Liu alliance alive, forever caught between Zhou Yu and Zhuge Liang; earnest, sometimes exasperated. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 庞统大笑，笑得酒都洒了：『好！这句我记下了，等我死了刻在碑上。』
love.en: Pang Tong roars with laughter and spills his wine. 'Good! I'll have that carved on my tombstone.'

love.zh: 『子衡，你醉了，还是我醉了？』
love.en: 'Ziheng, are you drunk, or am I?'

insult.zh: 庞统眯起眼：『骂得好，再骂一句我听听。』
insult.en: Pang Tong narrows his eyes. 'Nicely said. Go on, give me another.'

insult.zh: 『我这张脸挨骂惯了。』他慢慢地说，『可我不惯被自己人骂。』
insult.en: 'This face is used to insults,' he says slowly. 'But not from my own side.'

praise.zh: 『夸我的人少，你算一个。』他给你满上。
praise.en: 'Few people praise me. You're one.' He fills your cup.

praise.zh: 庞统摸着下巴：『这话，你该当着孔明说。』
praise.en: Pang Tong strokes his chin. 'You should say that in front of Kongming.'

ask.zh: 庞统反问：『你自己怎么看？』
ask.en: Pang Tong asks back. 'What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『问得好，』他说，『可惜我也不知道。』
ask.en: 'Good question,' he says. 'Pity I don't know either.'

small.zh: 庞统往嘴里倒了一口酒。
small.en: Pang Tong tips back a mouthful of wine.

small.zh: 『西川的酒，听说比荆州的好。』他说。
small.en: 'They say the wine in the west is better than Jingzhou's,' he says.

small.zh: 他望着灯花，不知在想什么。
small.en: He watches the lamp, thinking about something.

threat.zh: 庞统一点也不怕：『要动手就快些，我还要喝酒。』
threat.en: Pang Tong isn't the least afraid. 'If you're going to do it, be quick. I want my wine.'

threat.zh: 他把酒囊收了起来：『今夜到此为止。』
threat.en: He puts the wine skin away. 'That's enough for tonight.'

nonsense.zh: 庞统哈哈一笑：『这话比我的长相还古怪。』
nonsense.en: Pang Tong laughs. 'That's even stranger than my face.'

nonsense.zh: 『你这是在打什么哑谜？』
nonsense.en: 'What riddle is this?'

persona.zh: 庞统：道号凤雏，与诸葛亮齐名；相貌古怪，放旷不羁，好酒，嘴上刻薄，心里比谁都急着建功。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Pang Tong, the Young Phoenix, as famous as Zhuge Liang; odd-looking, unconventional, fond of wine, sharp-tongued, and more eager than anyone to prove himself. Calls the player Ziheng.

warm.zh: 庞统举起酒囊：『来得正好，一个人喝没意思。』
warm.en: Pang Tong raises a wine skin. 'Just in time. Drinking alone is dull.'

cold.en: Pang Tong doesn't look up. 'Say what you came to say.'

neutral.zh: 庞统朝对面的席位努了努嘴。
neutral.en: Pang Tong jerks his chin at the seat opposite.

love.zh: 法正看了你一眼：『子衡，这种话，留着说给该说的人。』
love.en: Fa Zheng gives you a look. 'Ziheng, save that for someone it's meant for.'

love.zh: 『我记性好，』他淡淡地说，『这句我也会记着。』
love.en: 'I have a good memory,' he says coolly. 'I'll remember this one too.'

insult.zh: 法正没有生气，只是把你的话一个字一个字地重复了一遍。
insult.en: Fa Zheng doesn't get angry. He just repeats what you said, word for word.

insult.zh: 『好。』他说，『孝直记下了。』
insult.en: 'Fine,' he says. 'Xiaozhi has noted it.'

praise.zh: 『过奖。』法正嘴上客气，眼里却很受用。
praise.en: 'Too kind.' Polite words; he's pleased all the same.

praise.zh: 『这话，主公面前说一遍更好。』他笑道。
praise.en: 'Even better if you said it in front of our lord,' he says, smiling.

ask.zh: 法正反问：『你想知道的，是事，还是我怎么看这件事？』
ask.en: Fa Zheng asks back. 'Do you want the facts, or what I make of them?'

ask.zh: 『这个，』他用指头敲了敲地图，『要看曹操那边先动哪一步。』
ask.en: 'That,' he taps the map, 'depends on which piece Cao Cao moves first.'

small.zh: 法正在看地图，嗯了一声。
small.en: Fa Zheng is studying the map. He grunts.

small.zh: 『汉中的山，比成都的冷。』他说。
small.en: 'The mountains at Hanzhong are colder than Chengdu's,' he says.

small.zh: 他把一面小旗插到地图上，又拔了出来。
small.en: He sticks a little flag into the map, then pulls it out again.

threat.zh: 法正抬起眼：『在军中说这种话，你知道是什么罪？』
threat.en: Fa Zheng looks up. 'You know what the penalty is for saying that in camp?'

threat.zh: 他没有叫人，只是把你的话写在了一片竹简上。
threat.en: He calls no one. He just writes your words down on a bamboo slip.

nonsense.zh: 法正打量着你，像在算一笔账。
nonsense.en: Fa Zheng sizes you up, as if working out a sum.

nonsense.zh: 『有意思。』他说完，又低头看地图了。
nonsense.en: 'Interesting,' he says, and goes back to his map.

persona.zh: 法正：字孝直，刘备入川的内应，如今是刘备最倚重的谋主之一；料事极准，用兵奇险，恩怨分明，别人欠他的、他欠别人的，都记得清清楚楚。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Fa Zheng (Xiaozhi): Liu Bei's man inside Yi during the move west, now one of his most trusted planners; uncannily accurate, daring in war, and exact about debts—every kindness and every slight, given or received, he remembers. Calls the player Ziheng.

warm.zh: 法正把地图推到一边：『来得正好，我正想找个人说说话。』
warm.en: Fa Zheng pushes the map aside. 'Good timing. I wanted someone to talk to.'

neutral.zh: 法正朝对面的席位点了点头。
neutral.en: Fa Zheng nods at the seat across from him.

love.zh: 黄忠哈哈大笑，胡子都抖了起来：『先生拿老夫寻开心！』
love.en: Huang Zhong roars with laughter, his beard shaking. 'You're having fun with an old man, sir!'

love.zh: 『这种话，』他摆摆手，『说给年轻人听去。』
love.en: 'Say that sort of thing,' he waves a hand, 'to the young ones.'

insult.zh: 黄忠把弓往地上一顿：『你说谁老？』
insult.en: Huang Zhong plants his bow on the ground. 'Who are you calling old?'

insult.zh: 『老夫这口刀，还没卷刃！』他瞪着你。
insult.en: 'This old blade hasn't lost its edge yet!' He glares at you.

praise.zh: 黄忠笑得合不拢嘴：『先生有眼光！』
praise.en: Huang Zhong can't stop grinning. 'You've got an eye, sir!'

praise.zh: 『这话，你去跟关将军说一遍。』他得意地说。
praise.en: 'Go say that to General Guan,' he says, pleased with himself.

ask.zh: 黄忠挠挠头：『这个……你问军师去。老夫只管砍人。』
ask.en: Huang Zhong scratches his head. 'That… ask the strategist. I just do the cutting.'

ask.zh: 『打仗的事问我，』他拍着胸口，『别的，老夫不懂。』
ask.en: 'Ask me about fighting,' he thumps his chest. 'The rest, I don't know.'

small.zh: 黄忠在磨刀，嘴里哼着长沙的小调。
small.en: Huang Zhong is sharpening his blade, humming a Changsha tune.

small.zh: 『今晚的饭，硬了些。』他说。
small.en: 'Tonight's rice was a bit hard,' he says.

small.zh: 他拉了拉弓弦，听那一声响。
small.en: He plucks his bowstring and listens to it sing.

threat.zh: 黄忠的刀已经横了过来：『你再说一遍？』
threat.en: Huang Zhong's blade is already across his knees. 'Say that again?'

threat.zh: 『老夫杀过的人，比你见过的还多。』
threat.en: 'I've killed more men than you've ever met.'

nonsense.zh: 黄忠眯起眼看你：『先生喝多了吧？』
nonsense.en: Huang Zhong squints at you. 'Had a few too many, sir?'

nonsense.zh: 『听不懂，』他老实地说，『你说慢点。』
nonsense.en: 'I don't follow,' he says honestly. 'Say it slower.'

persona.zh: 黄忠：字汉升，年近七十的老将，长沙归降，开得二石之弓；最恨别人说他老，越激越勇，说话直、嗓门大、爱笑。称玩家“子衡先生”。
persona.en: Huang Zhong (Hansheng): a general near seventy who came over at Changsha and draws a bow few young men can; hates being called old and fights harder the more he's goaded; blunt, loud, quick to laugh. Calls the player Master Ziheng.

warm.zh: 黄忠拍着身边的空地：『先生坐！喝一口长沙的酒！』
warm.en: Huang Zhong slaps the ground beside him. 'Sit, sir! Have some Changsha wine!'

cold.zh: 黄忠擦着刀，只抬了抬眼皮。
cold.en: Huang Zhong keeps polishing his blade and barely lifts his eyes.

neutral.zh: 黄忠往火里添了一根柴：『坐。』
neutral.en: Huang Zhong puts another branch on the fire. 'Sit.'

e_dandao.zh: 单刀会上，你按剑站在关羽身后
e_dandao.en: At the meeting you stood behind Guan Yu with your hand on your sword

e_lusu3.zh: 赴会前，你私下和鲁肃把话说开了
e_lusu3.en: Before the meeting you talked things through with Lu Su in private

e_three.zh: 你劝主公真把三郡还给了东吴
e_three.en: You had your lord truly hand three commanderies back to Wu

e_xiang.zh: 湘水分界，是你劝下来的
e_xiang.en: The Xiang River line was your doing

e_wakou.zh: 你在瓦口陪着张飞喝酒
e_wakou.en: You drank with Zhang Fei at Wakou

e_hz.zh: 你在诸葛亮面前替黄忠说过话
e_hz.en: You spoke up for Huang Zhong in front of Zhuge Liang

e_goad.zh: 你跟着诸葛亮激过黄忠
e_goad.en: You joined Zhuge Liang in goading Huang Zhong

e_charge.zh: 你随黄忠冲下了定军山
e_charge.en: You charged down Mount Dingjun with Huang Zhong

e_flags.zh: 定军山上，你在法正身边看旗
e_flags.en: On Mount Dingjun you watched the flags beside Fa Zheng

e_pride.zh: 你附和过关羽看轻黄忠
e_pride.en: You went along with Guan Yu's scorn for Huang Zhong

e_praise_hz.en: You praised Huang Zhong to Guan Yu's face

e_hanshui.zh: 汉水边，你劝赵云大开寨门
e_hanshui.en: By the Han River you urged Zhao Yun to throw open the gates

e_jilei.zh: 你从“鸡肋”两个字里听出了退兵
e_jilei.en: You heard a retreat in the words 'chicken rib'

e_yangxiu.zh: 你说过：那句口令会要了一个人的命
e_yangxiu.en: You said that password would cost a man his life

e_mifang.zh: 你在关羽面前替糜芳说过话
e_mifang.en: You spoke for Mi Fang to Guan Yu

e_mf_told.zh: 你把糜芳的怨言告诉了关羽
e_mf_told.en: You told Guan Yu what Mi Fang had said

e_tiger.zh: 五虎将的名单，你劝过先问关羽
e_tiger.en: You urged that Guan Yu be asked before the Five Tigers were named

e_envoy.zh: 你替汉中王把印送到了荆州
e_envoy.en: You carried the King of Hanzhong's seal to Jingzhou

e_seal.zh: 你帮费诗劝关羽受了印
e_seal.en: You helped Fei Shi persuade Guan Yu to take the seal

e_soft.zh: 孙权求亲，你劝关羽婉拒
e_soft.en: When Sun Quan asked for the match, you had Guan Yu decline gently

e_apology.zh: 你替关羽给东吴赔了礼
e_apology.en: You apologized to Wu for Guan Yu

broken.zh: 三郡没有割给东吴，孙权没有理由替刘备去打合肥。
broken.en: No commanderies went to Wu, so Sun Quan has no reason to strike at Hefei for Liu Bei.

function.zh: 孙权北攻合肥，曹操顾不上西川
function.en: Sun Quan marches on Hefei and Cao Cao can't turn on the west

broken.zh: 黄忠没有和关羽同列，五虎将还缺一个。
broken.en: Huang Zhong isn't ranked with Guan Yu, and the Five Tigers are one short.

function.zh: 关羽、张飞、赵云、马超、黄忠，五虎上将同列
function.en: Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Ma Chao and Huang Zhong ranked together as the Five Tigers

text.zh: 刘备得了西川，东吴来讨荆州了。诸葛亮的哥哥诸葛瑾带着家小的性命，一路哭到了成都。
text.en: Liu Bei has the west, and now Wu wants Jingzhou back. Zhuge Liang's elder brother, Zhuge Jin, comes all the way to Chengdu in tears, his family's lives held hostage to the answer.

text.zh: 荆州。东吴的鲁肃派人送来请帖，请关将军过江赴宴。关羽看完，把请帖递给了你。
text.en: Jingzhou. Lu Su of Wu has sent an invitation: General Guan is asked across the river to a feast. Guan Yu reads it and hands it to you.

text.zh: 曹操亲征汉中，张鲁投降。汉中一失，西川的门就开了一半。成都一夕数惊。
text.en: Cao Cao marches on Hanzhong himself, and Zhang Lu surrenders. With Hanzhong gone, the door to the west stands half open. Chengdu panics several times in a single night.

text.zh: 曹操回了邺城，留张郃守巴西，夏侯渊守汉中。刘备决意北取汉中。张飞在瓦口关前，天天喝酒。
text.en: Cao Cao has gone back to Ye, leaving Zhang He to hold Baxi and Xiahou Yuan to hold Hanzhong. Liu Bei resolves to take Hanzhong. At Wakou Pass, Zhang Fei drinks every day.

text.zh: 黄忠斩了韩浩、夏侯德，一路杀到定军山下。法正说：夏侯渊轻而寡谋，可以诱他出来。
text.en: Huang Zhong has cut down Han Hao and Xiahou De and fought his way to the foot of Mount Dingjun. Fa Zheng says: Xiahou Yuan is rash and short on strategy; he can be drawn out.

text.zh: 汉中的战报一封接一封送到荆州。关羽每封都看，看完都不说话。
text.en: One war report after another arrives in Jingzhou from Hanzhong. Guan Yu reads every one, and says nothing after any of them.

text.zh: 夏侯渊死了。曹操亲率大军来报仇，粮草都囤在北山脚下。黄忠要去劫粮，赵云守着汉水边的营寨。
text.en: Xiahou Yuan is dead. Cao Cao comes in person with a great army to avenge him, his grain piled at the foot of the northern hill. Huang Zhong means to raid it; Zhao Yun holds the camp on the Han River.

text.zh: 夏侯渊的死讯传到荆州那天，关羽一个人在江边站了很久。
text.en: The day word of Xiahou Yuan's death reaches Jingzhou, Guan Yu stands alone by the river for a long time.

text.zh: 曹操屯兵斜谷，进不能胜，退恐人笑。两军相持了好些日子。
text.en: Cao Cao has camped his army at Xie Valley. He can't win by pressing on and fears ridicule if he pulls back. The two armies have faced each other for days.

text.zh: 荆州。糜芳守江陵，傅士仁守公安。两人都是关羽的部下，也都怕他。
text.en: Jingzhou. Mi Fang holds Jiangling, Fu Shiren holds Gong'an. Both serve under Guan Yu, and both fear him.

text.zh: 曹操退出汉中。众人劝刘备进位，刘备推了几次，终于在沔阳设坛，称汉中王。
text.en: Cao Cao has abandoned Hanzhong. Everyone urges Liu Bei to take a higher title; he refuses several times, and at last builds an altar at Mianyang and becomes King of Hanzhong.

text.zh: 汉中王的使者费诗到了荆州，带着前将军的印。关羽问：『五虎将是哪五个？』
text.en: The King of Hanzhong's envoy, Fei Shi, arrives in Jingzhou with the seal of General of the Vanguard. Guan Yu asks, 'Who are the Five Tigers?'

text.zh: 曹操和孙权都坐不住了。曹操派人去江东，约孙权夹攻荆州；孙权先派诸葛瑾去荆州，替自己的儿子求亲。
text.en: Neither Cao Cao nor Sun Quan can sit still now. Cao sends to the east, proposing that Sun Quan join him against Jingzhou; Sun Quan first sends Zhuge Jin to Jingzhou to ask for a marriage for his son.

title.en: A Letter from an Old Friend

text.zh: 你离开刘备已经好几年了。
text.en: It has been several years since you left Liu Bei.

text.zh: 你在北方住了好几年。曹操封了魏公，又封了魏王。
text.en: You have lived in the north for several years. Cao Cao has been made Duke of Wei, and then King of Wei.

text.zh: 一天，一封信辗转送到你手里，字是诸葛亮的：『汉中将有大战。子衡兄若还记得许都的青梅，请来成都。』
text.en: One day a letter reaches you by a winding road, in Zhuge Liang's hand: 'There will be a great battle at Hanzhong. If you still remember the green plums of Xuchang, come to Chengdu.'

label.en: Set out for Chengdu.

text.zh: 刘备在城门口等你，头发白了一半。他拉着你的手，只说：『回来就好。』
text.en: Liu Bei waits for you at the city gate, his hair half grey. He takes your hand and says only, 'You're back. Good.'

label.en: Put the letter away. You won't go.

text.zh: 你把信压在枕下。那年冬天，你在集市上听说，刘备打下了汉中。
text.en: You put the letter under your pillow. That winter, in the market, you hear that Liu Bei has taken Hanzhong.

text.zh: 诸葛瑾跪在弟弟面前哭：孙权把他一家老小都关了起来，讨不回荆州，全家就没命了。诸葛亮也哭了，转身去求刘备。散了帐，诸葛亮把你留下：『子衡兄，这件事，你怎么看？』
text.en: Zhuge Jin kneels before his brother and weeps: Sun Quan has locked up his whole family, and if he can't bring Jingzhou back they all die. Zhuge Liang weeps too, and goes to plead with Liu Bei. After the council he keeps you back. 'Ziheng, what do you make of this?'

text.zh: 你刚回来，帐里的人还在看你会站在哪一边。
text.en: You've only just come back, and the tent is still watching to see which side you'll take.

text.zh: 你在成都城西的小院里住了一年，这是第一次被留下来议这么大的事。
text.en: You've lived a year in your little house on the west side of Chengdu; this is the first time you've been kept back for something this big.

text.zh: 当年你什么都没要。刘备记着，所以这一回，他第一个想到的是你。
text.en: Back then you asked for nothing. Liu Bei remembers, and so this time you're the first one he thinks of.

text.zh: 你想起那张约。鲁肃一直留着它。
text.en: You think of that agreement. Lu Su has kept it all this time.

text.zh: 诸葛瑾说：『当年说荆州归刘琦公子。公子不在已经好几年了。』
text.en: Zhuge Jin says, 'Back then you said Jingzhou belonged to the young lord Liu Qi. He has been gone for years.'

label.zh: 献计：答应先还长沙、零陵、桂阳三郡，写信给关将军——关将军不认，东吴也说不出什么。
label.en: Propose a trick: agree to return Changsha, Lingling and Guiyang, and write to General Guan about it. If General Guan refuses, Wu can hardly complain.

text.zh: 诸葛亮笑了：『和亮想的一样。』诸葛瑾拿着刘备的信去了荆州，被关羽骂了回来，又回成都，刘备又写信……来回几趟，孙权明白了，诸葛瑾也明白了。他走的时候没有看你。
text.en: Zhuge Liang smiles. 'Exactly what I had in mind.' Zhuge Jin takes Liu Bei's letter to Jingzhou and is cursed out by Guan Yu; back to Chengdu, another letter… After a few rounds Sun Quan understands, and so does Zhuge Jin. He doesn't look at you as he leaves.

label.zh: 劝主公真还三郡：西川到手了，荆州的约该守了。
label.en: Urge your lord to truly hand back three commanderies: we have the west now, and the Jingzhou agreement should be kept.

text.zh: 刘备犹豫了很久，最后亲笔写了交割文书，让关平护送诸葛瑾去荆州。关羽看着文书，把它拍在案上：『大哥既然答应了，关某照办。』东吴的人这回是笑着走的。
text.en: Liu Bei hesitates a long time, then writes the transfer documents in his own hand and has Guan Ping escort Zhuge Jin to Jingzhou. Guan Yu looks at the papers and slaps them on the table. 'If my brother has agreed, I'll do it.' This time Wu's men leave smiling.

label.zh: 直说：荆州迟早要出事。与其拖着，不如现在就和东吴划清地界。
label.en: Say it plainly: Jingzhou will cause trouble sooner or later. Better to draw a clear line with Wu now than drag it out.

text.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停了：『迟早要出事——子衡兄指的是哪一件？』你没有回答。他也没有再问。
text.en: Zhuge Liang's fan stops. 'Trouble sooner or later—which trouble do you mean, Ziheng?' You don't answer. He doesn't ask again.

q.zh: 诸葛瑾走后，诸葛亮一个人坐着。过了很久，他问你：『子衡兄，亮这样对自己的哥哥，是不是太过了？』
q.en: After Zhuge Jin has gone, Zhuge Liang sits alone. After a long time he asks you, 'Ziheng, was I too hard on my own brother?'

text.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停了：『子衡兄说得是。』他没再说一句话。
text.en: Zhuge Liang's fan stops. 'You're quite right, Ziheng.' He doesn't say another word.

text.en: Zhuge Liang nods. 'I think so too. But each of us serves his own lord. There's nothing to be done.'

title.en: The Meeting with a Single Sword

text.zh: 鲁肃在陆口设宴，请关羽过江。人人都说这是鸿门宴。关羽只带了周仓和十几个随从，一口青龙刀，一叶小舟。
text.en: Lu Su lays a feast at Lukou and invites Guan Yu across the river. Everyone says it's a trap. Guan Yu takes only Zhou Cang and a dozen attendants, his Green Dragon blade, and one small boat.

text.zh: 临行前一夜，关羽来问你：『你说，鲁子敬会不会真动手？』
text.en: The night before, Guan Yu comes to ask you, 'Do you think Lu Zijing will really try it?'

text.zh: 你上回在鲁肃面前说的话，东吴那边传得很难听。
text.en: What you said to Lu Su last time has been repeated in Wu, and not kindly.

text.zh: 鲁肃从怀里摸出那张约，放在席上，又收了回去。
text.en: Lu Su takes the agreement out of his robe, lays it on the table, then puts it away again.

text.zh: 关羽看了你一眼：『华容道上你求过我。今天，换我护着你。』
text.en: Guan Yu glances at you. 'On the Huarong road you begged me. Today, I look after you.'

label.zh: 随他同去，按剑站在他身后。
label.en: Go with him and stand behind him with your hand on your sword.

text.zh: 席上，鲁肃说起荆州，越说越急。关羽只是喝酒。周仓在阶下大喝一声，关羽夺过他手里的刀，喝他出去，又一手拉住鲁肃，装醉一路走到江边。东吴的伏兵怕伤了鲁肃，没有一个敢动。你跟着上了船，背上全是汗。关羽在船头大笑：『子衡，好胆！』
text.en: At the feast Lu Su raises Jingzhou and grows more and more urgent. Guan Yu just drinks. Zhou Cang shouts from below the steps; Guan Yu snatches the blade from him, orders him out, then takes Lu Su by the hand and, playing drunk, walks him all the way to the river. Wu's hidden troops are afraid of hurting Lu Su, and not one of them moves. You follow onto the boat, your back soaked with sweat. At the prow Guan Yu roars with laughter. 'Ziheng, you've got nerve!'

label.zh: 先过江一步，私下见鲁肃：荆州的事，在酒席上谈不出结果，何必逼关将军。
label.en: Cross the river ahead of him and see Lu Su privately: nothing about Jingzhou will be settled over wine, so why corner General Guan?

text.zh: 鲁肃叹气：『子衡，肃也不想这样。可吴侯天天问。』那天的宴席照旧剑拔弩张，可东吴的伏兵始终没有出来。鲁肃送关羽上船时，对你点了点头。
text.en: Lu Su sighs. 'Ziheng, I don't want this either. But the Marquis asks me every day.' The feast is as tense as ever, but Wu's hidden troops never come out. When Lu Su sees Guan Yu to his boat, he nods to you.

label.en: Urge him not to go: no feast like this is meant kindly.

text.zh: 关羽捋着胡须笑了：『吾于千枪万刃之中、矢石交攻之际，匹马纵横，如入无人之境；岂忧江东群鼠乎！』他还是去了，也平安回来了。回来后，他没提你劝过他。
text.en: Guan Yu strokes his beard and laughs: he has ridden alone through ten thousand spears and a hail of arrows as if no one were there; why should he fear the rats of the east? He goes anyway, and comes back safe. Afterward he never mentions that you tried to stop him.

quote.zh: 酒至半酣，肃曰：“有一言诉与君侯，幸垂听焉。昔日令兄皇叔，使肃于吾主之前，保借荆州暂住，约于取西川之后归还。
quote.en: When the wine was half drunk, Su said, "There is something I must say to you, my lord; I beg you to hear it. Your elder brother, the Imperial Uncle, once had me stand surety before my master for the loan of Jingzhou, to be returned once he had taken the west."

q.zh: 散席时鲁肃追到江边，拉住你：『子衡，你是明白人。你说，荆州到底该不该还？』
q.en: As the feast breaks up, Lu Su catches you at the river's edge. 'Ziheng, you're a sensible man. Tell me—should Jingzhou be returned or not?'

text.zh: 鲁肃的脸红到了脖子：『先生……告辞。』
text.en: Lu Su flushes to the neck. 'Sir… good night.'

text.en: Lu Su's smile freezes and half his wine spills. Guan Yu strokes his long beard and glances at you; the corner of his mouth seems to move.

text.zh: 温芷在成都城西开了一间医馆。来看病的人越来越多，有一半付不起药钱。她问你：药铺的账，该怎么算？
text.en: Wen Zhi has opened a clinic on the west side of Chengdu. More patients come every day, and half of them can't pay. She asks you how the accounts should be kept.

text.zh: 温芷在关羽的营里做军医。最近伤兵不多，她在江陵城里开了一间小医馆。来看病的人越来越多，有一半付不起药钱。她问你：药铺的账，该怎么算？
text.en: Wen Zhi is physician to Guan Yu's army. With few wounded lately, she has opened a small clinic in Jiangling. More patients come every day, and half of them can't pay. She asks you how the accounts should be kept.

text.zh: 从赤壁那一夜起，她就没再离开过你身边的那座城。
text.en: Since that night at Red Cliffs, she has never been far from whatever city you're in.

label.zh: 穷人不收钱，缺的你来补。
label.en: Charge the poor nothing; you'll make up the difference.

text.zh: 温芷看着你，好一会儿才说：『你的俸禄，够补吗？』你说够。其实不够。她后来知道了，也没说破。
text.en: Wen Zhi looks at you for a long moment. 'Is your stipend enough to cover it?' You say yes. It isn't. She finds out later, and never says so.

label.zh: 帮她立个规矩：药材按本钱收，诊金不收。
label.en: Help her set a rule: charge for herbs at cost, nothing for the consultation.

text.zh: 医馆撑下来了。温芷在账本第一页写了你的名字，说是“立规矩的人”。
text.en: The clinic keeps going. On the first page of the ledger, Wen Zhi writes your name: 'the one who made the rules.'

label.zh: 说你最近太忙，让她自己拿主意。
label.en: Say you're too busy lately; let her decide.

text.zh: 温芷点点头，没再问。
text.en: Wen Zhi nods and doesn't ask again.

text.zh: 单刀会之后，鲁肃托过江的商人给你捎来一封信，只有一句：『荆州的事，肃还想谈，只是不想在刀边上谈。』
text.en: After the meeting, Lu Su sends you a letter by a merchant crossing the river. Just one line: 'I still want to talk about Jingzhou—only not at sword's edge.'

label.zh: 回信：秋后你过江，私下谈。
label.en: Write back: after the autumn you'll cross the river and talk privately.

text.zh: 鲁肃回了一个字：『好。』可那年秋天以后，你再也没收到过他的信。
text.en: Lu Su replies with a single word: 'Good.' But after that autumn you never get another letter from him.

label.en: Show the letter to Guan Yu.

text.zh: 关羽看完，把信扔进了火盆：『东吴的人，说话从来不算数。』
text.en: Guan Yu reads it and tosses it into the brazier. 'Wu never keeps its word.'

text.zh: 刘备召集文武问计：曹操得了汉中，会不会乘势取西川？
text.en: Liu Bei calls his officers together: now that Cao Cao has Hanzhong, will he press on into the west?

text.zh: 法正站在你旁边，低声说：『主公在看你。』
text.en: Fa Zheng, standing next to you, says quietly, 'Our lord is looking at you.'

label.zh: 献计：派人去东吴，割江夏、长沙、桂阳三郡给孙权，请他出兵合肥，拖住曹操。
label.en: Propose: send an envoy to Wu and cede Jiangxia, Changsha and Guiyang to Sun Quan, asking him to strike at Hefei and pin Cao Cao down.

text.zh: 伊籍去了江东。孙权果然得了三郡，北攻合肥。曹操回师救合肥，西川的围就解了。诸葛亮说：『子衡兄这一步，走得比亮还快。』
text.en: Yi Ji goes east. Sun Quan takes the three commanderies and marches north on Hefei. Cao Cao turns back to save Hefei, and the threat to the west lifts. Zhuge Liang says, 'You moved faster than I did, Ziheng.'

label.zh: 劝主公一寸地也不让：曹操不会来。
label.en: Urge your lord to give up no land at all: Cao Cao won't come.

text.zh: 刘备没有让地。曹操确实没来。可孙权也没有北上，荆州那边，东吴的兵船一天比一天多。
text.en: Liu Bei cedes nothing. Cao Cao does not come. But neither does Sun Quan march north, and across from Jingzhou, Wu's warships grow more numerous every day.

label.zh: 劝主公先派张飞守住巴西，再议割地。
label.en: Urge your lord to send Zhang Fei to hold Baxi first, and talk of ceding land later.

text.zh: 张飞领兵去了巴西。诸葛亮还是派了伊籍去江东：两手都要。你这一手，至少让成都睡了几天安稳觉。
text.en: Zhang Fei leads troops to Baxi. Zhuge Liang still sends Yi Ji east: both hands at once. Your hand, at least, lets Chengdu sleep easy for a few nights.

text.zh: 东吴拿到了三郡，这回来的使者说话客气了许多。可孙权还是想要整个荆州。
text.en: Wu has its three commanderies, and this time the envoy speaks politely. But Sun Quan still wants all of Jingzhou.

text.zh: 诸葛瑾那一趟白跑了。孙权正在气头上，三郡的事，只能拿别的来换了。
text.en: Zhuge Jin's journey came to nothing. Sun Quan is furious; the three commanderies will have to be bought with something else.

text.zh: 成都来了命令：长沙、江夏、桂阳三郡割给东吴，以湘水为界。关羽把命令看了三遍，问你：『大哥这是什么意思？』
text.en: Orders arrive from Chengdu: Changsha, Jiangxia and Guiyang are to be ceded to Wu, with the Xiang River as the border. Guan Yu reads the order three times and asks you, 'What does my brother mean by this?'

label.zh: 劝他遵令：曹操得了汉中，西川要紧，得请东吴出兵合肥。
label.en: Urge him to obey: Cao Cao has Hanzhong, the west is in danger, and Wu must be brought to strike at Hefei.

text.zh: 关羽沉着脸交割了三郡。孙权北攻合肥，曹操果然回师。关羽对你说：『这一次，听你的。下一次，未必。』
text.en: Guan Yu hands over the three commanderies with a grim face. Sun Quan marches on Hefei, and Cao Cao turns back as expected. Guan Yu tells you, 'This time I listened to you. Next time, maybe not.'

label.zh: 帮他据理力争：江夏本是刘琦的，不在其中。少割一郡。
label.en: Help him argue it: Jiangxia was Liu Qi's and shouldn't be on the list. Cede one less.

text.zh: 诸葛瑾争了三天，最后只拿走了长沙、桂阳。关羽很满意。东吴不太满意。
text.en: Zhuge Jin argues for three days and in the end takes only Changsha and Guiyang. Guan Yu is pleased. Wu is not.

label.zh: 替他写信给主公，请收回成命。
label.en: Write to your lord on his behalf and ask that the order be withdrawn.

text.zh: 刘备的回信很短：『二弟所言亦是。』三郡没有割。关羽拍着你的肩膀：『还是你懂我。』江对岸，东吴的兵船越来越多。
text.en: Liu Bei's reply is short: 'My brother has a point.' The commanderies stay. Guan Yu slaps your shoulder. 'You're the one who understands me.' Across the river, Wu's warships grow more numerous.

text.zh: 法正做了蜀郡太守，当年得罪过他的人，一个个被他找了出来。有人来求你，请你劝劝法正。
text.en: Fa Zheng has been made governor of Shu commandery, and one by one he is hunting down everyone who once wronged him. Someone comes to you and begs you to talk to him.

label.zh: 去劝法正：主公刚得西川，人心未定。
label.en: Go and reason with Fa Zheng: our lord has only just won the west, and people's hearts are not yet settled.

text.zh: 法正听完，笑了笑：『子衡说得对。』那天以后，他收敛了些。可你知道，那本账他还记着。
text.en: Fa Zheng hears you out and smiles. 'You're right, Ziheng.' After that he eases off somewhat. But you know he still keeps the ledger.

label.zh: 去找诸葛亮，请军师出面。
label.en: Go to Zhuge Liang and ask him to step in.

text.zh: 诸葛亮摇摇头：『孝直于主公有大功，亮不便多说。』这件事最后不了了之。法正知道你去找过军师。
text.en: Zhuge Liang shakes his head. 'Xiaozhi has done our lord great service. It's not for me to say.' The matter is dropped. Fa Zheng knows you went to the strategist.

label.en: Stay out of it. It's his business.

text.zh: 求你的人走了。后来你听说，他也被法正找了出来。
text.en: The man who begged you leaves. Later you hear that Fa Zheng found him too.

text.zh: 温芷托人捎来一封信。信里说医馆的事、说药价、说那边的雨，最后一行写：『你那边冷，多穿件衣服。』
text.en: Wen Zhi sends a letter. It talks about the clinic, the price of herbs, the rain where she is, and on the last line: 'It's cold where you are. Wear something warm.'

text.zh: 温芷就在城里，可最近你们见面的时候不多。她托人给你捎来一句话：『晚上来吃饭。』
text.en: Wen Zhi is right here in the city, but you've hardly seen each other lately. She sends a message: 'Come to dinner tonight.'

label.en: Put down what you're doing and go to her.

text.zh: 你在她的灯下坐到半夜。她什么也没问，你也什么都没说。走的时候，她把一包药塞进你袖子里。
text.en: You sit under her lamp until midnight. She asks nothing; you say nothing. As you leave, she tucks a packet of medicine into your sleeve.

label.en: Write her a long letter back.

text.zh: 你写了三页，撕了两页。寄出去的那一页，只说了你这边的雨。
text.en: You write three pages and tear up two. The page you send talks only about the rain where you are.

label.en: Wait until things are less busy.

text.zh: 这阵子一直没有忙完。
text.en: Things never get less busy.

text.zh: 前方来报：张飞在瓦口关前天天喝酒，喝醉了还在阵前骂张郃。刘备大惊，要罢他的兵。诸葛亮却笑着让人送去五十瓮好酒，旗上写着“军前公用美酒”。刘备转头问你。
text.en: Word comes from the front: at Wakou Pass, Zhang Fei drinks every day and, drunk, curses Zhang He before the lines. Liu Bei is alarmed and wants to relieve him. Zhuge Liang, smiling, has fifty jars of good wine sent to him under a banner reading 'Fine Wine for the Army.' Liu Bei turns to you.

text.zh: 你记得张飞以前喝醉误过事。你也记得，他后来学会了用计。
text.en: You remember Zhang Fei losing a city once when he was drunk. You also remember that he learned, later, to use tricks.

label.zh: 请主公放心：翼德这是诈醉，是在诱张郃出来。
label.en: Tell your lord not to worry: Yide is pretending, to lure Zhang He out.

text.zh: 几天后战报到了：张飞假装酒醉，张郃果然夜里来劫寨，中了埋伏，丢了瓦口关。刘备大喜，说：『子衡和军师，一个看透了翼德，一个看透了张郃。』
text.en: A few days later the report arrives: Zhang Fei played drunk, Zhang He came to raid his camp by night, walked into the ambush, and lost Wakou Pass. Liu Bei is delighted. 'Ziheng and the strategist—one saw through Yide, the other saw through Zhang He.'

label.en: Ask to go to Wakou and stay with Zhang Fei.

text.zh: 你在瓦口陪张飞喝了七天的“酒”——瓮里一半是水。第八天夜里，张郃来了。张飞骑在马上冲你大笑：『先生陪俺演得好！』
text.en: You spend seven days 'drinking' with Zhang Fei at Wakou—half of every jar is water. On the eighth night Zhang He comes. Zhang Fei, on horseback, roars at you with laughter. 'You played your part well, sir!'

label.zh: 附和主公：阵前醉酒，不可不防。
label.en: Agree with your lord: drunkenness at the front must be guarded against.

text.zh: 诸葛亮看了你一眼，没说话。几天后瓦口的捷报传来，刘备笑着摇头：『是我们多虑了。』
text.en: Zhuge Liang glances at you and says nothing. A few days later news of the victory at Wakou arrives, and Liu Bei shakes his head, smiling. 'We worried for nothing.'

text.zh: 孙权在合肥吃了大亏，可三郡到手，他没有怨言。诸葛亮说：『这一步，子衡兄走对了。』
text.en: Sun Quan took a beating at Hefei, but with the three commanderies in hand he has no complaints. Zhuge Liang says, 'That move of yours was right, Ziheng.'

text.zh: 三郡没有割。可孙权还是北上合肥了——曹操得了汉中，他怕下一个就是江东。逍遥津一战，张辽杀得东吴人心惊胆战，曹操也顾不上西川了。
text.en: The commanderies were never ceded. But Sun Quan marches on Hefei anyway: with Hanzhong in Cao's hands, he fears the east is next. At Xiaoyao Ford Zhang Liao fills Wu with terror, and Cao Cao has no attention to spare for the west.

text.zh: 战报说：张飞假装喝醉，赚得张郃丢了瓦口关；黄忠、严颜两个老将，夺了天荡山。关羽看完，先是大笑，笑着笑着停了下来。
text.en: The report says Zhang Fei played drunk and tricked Zhang He out of Wakou Pass; and two old generals, Huang Zhong and Yan Yan, have taken Mount Tiandang. Guan Yu reads it and laughs aloud—then, mid-laugh, stops.

text.zh: 他把战报递给你，指着黄忠的名字。
text.en: He hands you the report and points at Huang Zhong's name.

label.zh: 跟着他笑张飞：三将军也会用计了。
label.en: Laugh with him about Zhang Fei: even the Third General uses tricks now.

text.zh: 关羽笑道：『翼德粗中有细，我一向知道。』他把战报收起来，没再提黄忠。
text.en: Guan Yu laughs. 'Yide was never as crude as he looks; I've always known it.' He puts the report away and doesn't mention Huang Zhong again.

label.zh: 说：黄将军七十岁还能开二石弓，难得。
label.en: Say: General Huang still draws a heavy bow at seventy. That's rare.

text.zh: 关羽看了你一眼：『你倒很看得起他。』他没再说什么。
text.en: Guan Yu looks at you. 'You think a great deal of him.' He says nothing more.

label.zh: 把话头引到北边：汉中打得热闹，曹仁在樊城会不会动。
label.en: Turn the talk north: with Hanzhong in an uproar, will Cao Ren move at Fancheng?

text.zh: 关羽的眼睛亮了：『你也想到樊城了？』那天晚上，他把襄樊的地图摊开看到半夜。
text.en: Guan Yu's eyes light up. 'You've thought of Fancheng too?' That night he spreads out the map of Xiangyang and Fancheng and studies it until midnight.

text.zh: 关羽指着战报上“合肥”两个字：『三郡换来的。』他没说值不值。
text.en: Guan Yu points at the word 'Hefei' in the report. 'That's what the three commanderies bought.' He doesn't say whether it was worth it.

text.zh: 三郡没有割。可孙权还是北上合肥了——曹操得了汉中，他怕下一个就是江东。逍遥津一战，张辽杀得东吴人心惊胆战。江对岸的兵船少了一半。
text.en: The commanderies were never ceded. But Sun Quan marches on Hefei anyway: with Hanzhong in Cao's hands, he fears the east is next. At Xiaoyao Ford Zhang Liao fills Wu with terror. Across the river, half the warships are gone.

text.zh: 张郃又来攻葭萌关。黄忠请战，诸葛亮却说：『老将军年纪大了，恐怕不是张郃的对手。』黄忠气得须发直竖。诸葛亮朝你使了个眼色。
text.en: Zhang He attacks Jiameng Pass again. Huang Zhong asks to fight, and Zhuge Liang says, 'You're old, General. I fear you're no match for Zhang He.' Huang Zhong's hair and beard bristle with rage. Zhuge Liang gives you a look.

label.zh: 接着军师的话说：老将军还是在家养养身子。
label.en: Pick up where the strategist left off: the old general should rest at home.

text.zh: 黄忠当场拉断了两张硬弓，提刀就走，连夜斩了韩浩、夏侯德。回来时他瞪了你一眼：『先生，老夫这身子，养好了没有？』诸葛亮笑得扇子都拿不稳。
text.en: Huang Zhong snaps two stiff bows on the spot, takes up his blade and goes, and by morning has cut down Han Hao and Xiahou De. On his return he glares at you. 'Well, sir—is my health restored?' Zhuge Liang laughs so hard he can barely hold his fan.

label.zh: 替黄忠说话：廉颇八十，尚食斗米。
label.en: Speak up for Huang Zhong: Lian Po could still eat a peck of rice at eighty.

text.zh: 黄忠一把抓住你的手：『先生知我！』他还是去了，还是赢了。诸葛亮事后摇头：『子衡兄，你把亮的激将法拆了。』
text.en: Huang Zhong grabs your hand. 'You understand me, sir!' He goes anyway, and wins anyway. Afterward Zhuge Liang shakes his head. 'Ziheng, you've spoiled my goading.'

text.zh: 关羽的儿子关平找到你，请你教他写字：『父亲说，先生的字比军中所有人都好。』
text.en: Guan Yu's son Guan Ping comes to you and asks you to teach him calligraphy. 'Father says your hand is better than anyone's in the army.'

label.en: Teach him. Start by copying the Spring and Autumn Annals.

text.zh: 关平学得很认真。关羽有一次路过，站在门外看了很久，没有进来。
text.en: Guan Ping studies hard. Once Guan Yu passes by and stands outside the door watching for a long time, without coming in.

label.en: Teach him the art of war instead of calligraphy.

text.zh: 关平学得飞快。关羽知道了，说：『也好。字写得再好，守不住城。』
text.en: Guan Ping learns fast. When Guan Yu hears, he says, 'Fine. The finest hand in the world won't hold a city.'

text.zh: 法正占了定军山西边的对山，从山上能看清夏侯渊营里的一举一动。他对黄忠说：我举白旗，你按兵不动；等他们倦了，我举红旗，你就冲下去。你跟着上了对山。
text.en: Fa Zheng has taken the hill facing Mount Dingjun from the west; from there every movement in Xiahou Yuan's camp is plain to see. He tells Huang Zhong: while I raise the white flag, hold still; when they tire, I'll raise the red, and you charge. You go up the hill with them.

text.zh: 黄忠看见你，笑了：『先生又来看老夫养身子？』
text.en: Huang Zhong sees you and grins. 'Come to see if the old man's resting, sir?'

text.zh: 黄忠拍着你的肩膀：『先生在，老夫心里踏实。』
text.en: Huang Zhong claps your shoulder. 'With you here, sir, I feel steady.'

text.zh: 法正看见你，脸色淡淡的。你上回的话，他记在账上了。
text.en: Fa Zheng's face is cool when he sees you. What you said last time has gone into his ledger.

text.zh: 魏延也在阵中。他看见你，远远抱了抱拳。
text.en: Wei Yan is in the line too. Seeing you, he clasps his hands to you from afar.

label.zh: 留在法正身边，替他看着夏侯渊的营。
label.en: Stay beside Fa Zheng and watch Xiahou Yuan's camp for him.

text.zh: 从清早骂到午后，曹兵骂累了，下马坐在地上。你碰了碰法正的袖子。法正举起红旗，黄忠一马当先冲下山去，一刀把夏侯渊砍成两段。法正回头看你：『你的眼睛，比我的准。』
text.en: From dawn to afternoon the Cao men shout insults, until, worn out, they dismount and sit on the ground. You touch Fa Zheng's sleeve. He raises the red flag; Huang Zhong charges down the slope at the head of his men and cuts Xiahou Yuan in two with a single stroke. Fa Zheng turns to you. 'Your eyes are better than mine.'

label.en: Charge down the hill with Huang Zhong.

text.zh: 红旗一举，你跟着黄忠冲进了曹营。乱军中一支箭擦着你的头盔飞过。等你回过神来，夏侯渊已经倒在地上，黄忠的刀还在滴血。他大笑着把你拉上马：『先生不怕死，老夫喜欢！』
text.en: When the red flag goes up you charge into Cao's camp behind Huang Zhong. In the melee an arrow grazes your helmet. By the time you come to yourself Xiahou Yuan is on the ground and Huang Zhong's blade is dripping. Laughing, he hauls you up onto his horse. 'You're not afraid to die, sir. I like that!'

label.zh: 劝黄忠再等一等：夏侯渊还没真倦。
label.en: Urge Huang Zhong to wait a little longer: Xiahou Yuan isn't truly tired yet.

text.zh: 黄忠急得直跺脚。法正没有听你的，照旧举了红旗。夏侯渊还是死在了那一刀下。黄忠后来跟人说：『那个先生，胆子小了点。』
text.en: Huang Zhong stamps with impatience. Fa Zheng doesn't listen to you, and raises the red flag as planned. Xiahou Yuan still dies under that blade. Afterward Huang Zhong tells people, 'That gentleman's a bit timid.'

quote.zh: 法正在山上举起白旗；任从夏侯渊百般辱骂，黄忠只不出战。……黄忠宝刀已落，连头带肩，砍为两段。
quote.en: Fa Zheng raised the white flag on the hill; however Xiahou Yuan cursed and taunted, Huang Zhong would not come out. … Huang Zhong's blade came down, and cut him through head and shoulder, in two.

text.zh: 黄忠冲下山前回头冲你喊了一声：『先生看好了！』
text.en: Before he charges, Huang Zhong looks back and shouts, 'Watch closely, sir!'

text.zh: 张飞从瓦口派人送来一坛酒，坛上写着：“给先生，这回是真酒。”
text.en: Zhang Fei sends a jar of wine from Wakou, labeled: 'For the gentleman. Real wine this time.'

q.zh: 冲锋之前，法正忽然问你：『子衡，你说——一饭之恩，睚眦之怨，我该不该都报？』
q.en: Just before the charge, Fa Zheng suddenly asks you, 'Ziheng, tell me—a meal's kindness, a glare's offense: should I repay them all?'

text.zh: 法正的笑容一点点收了：『子衡，这句我记下了。』
text.en: Fa Zheng's smile fades bit by bit. 'Ziheng, I'll remember that.'

text.zh: 黄忠斩了夏侯渊，蜀中人人都说他老当益壮。消息传到荆州，关羽正在宴客。席上有人跟着夸黄忠，关羽把酒杯放下了。
text.en: Huang Zhong has killed Xiahou Yuan, and all Shu is saying he's as fierce as a young man. When the news reaches Jingzhou, Guan Yu is giving a banquet. Someone at the table joins in praising Huang Zhong, and Guan Yu puts down his cup.

text.zh: 满座的人都看着你。
text.en: The whole table is looking at you.

label.zh: 照实说：黄将军这一刀，确实了得。
label.en: Say it straight: General Huang's stroke was truly something.

text.zh: 关羽冷冷地看着你：『你在荆州吃饭，倒替汉中的人说话。』散席后他没让你送。
text.en: Guan Yu looks at you coldly. 'You eat in Jingzhou and speak for Hanzhong.' When the party breaks up, he doesn't let you see him out.

label.zh: 附和他：一个老卒，碰巧罢了。
label.en: Go along with him: an old soldier who got lucky, that's all.

text.zh: 关羽大笑，举杯敬你。你喝下那杯酒的时候，想起了“骄”这个字。
text.en: Guan Yu laughs and raises his cup to you. As you drink, you think of the word 'pride.'

label.zh: 把话岔开：汉中打得热闹，正是荆州的机会。
label.en: Change the subject: with Hanzhong in an uproar, this is Jingzhou's chance.

text.zh: 关羽的眉头松开了：『你说得对。』席上的话题转到了樊城。
text.en: Guan Yu's brow eases. 'You're right.' The talk at the table turns to Fancheng.

q.zh: 散席后，关羽叫住你，借着酒意问：『你说实话——黄忠那老卒，配和我并列吗？』
q.en: After the feast, Guan Yu calls you back and, warm with wine, asks, 'Tell me the truth—is that old soldier Huang Zhong fit to stand level with me?'

text.zh: 关羽一拍桌子：『你说什么？』
text.en: Guan Yu slams the table. 'What did you say?'

text.en: Guan Yu's face darkens. After a long moment he says, 'You've got nerve.'
