text.zh: 定军山下的营里，法正一个人在灯下看地图。他听见你进来，没抬头：『坐。』
text.en: In the camp below Mount Dingjun, Fa Zheng studies a map alone by lamplight. Hearing you come in, he doesn't look up. 'Sit.'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 法正送你到帐门口：『明天在山上，你站我旁边。』
text.en: Fa Zheng walks you to the tent flap. 'Tomorrow on the hill, stand beside me.'

label.zh: 问他：当年得罪过你的人，你都记着？
label.en: Ask him: do you remember everyone who ever wronged you?

text.zh: 法正笑了：『一个都没忘。帮过我的人，我也一个都没忘。』他看了你一眼，『子衡，你是哪一种？』
text.en: Fa Zheng smiles. 'Not one. And not one of those who helped me, either.' He glances at you. 'Which kind are you, Ziheng?'

label.en: Ask him: after Hanzhong, what then?

text.zh: 法正用指头在地图上从汉中划到长安：『这一步走成了，就是高祖的路。』他的手停在长安，没有再往前。
text.en: Fa Zheng traces a line on the map from Hanzhong to Chang'an. 'Get this step right, and it's the road the Founder took.' His finger stops at Chang'an and goes no further.

label.zh: 劝他保重身体：你的咳嗽一直没好。
label.en: Tell him to look after himself: that cough of his has never gone away.

text.zh: 法正愣了一下，摆摆手：『打完这一仗再说。』他咳了两声，又低头看地图。
text.en: Fa Zheng pauses, then waves it off. 'After this battle.' He coughs twice and goes back to his map.

text.zh: 定军山之战后，伤兵一车一车地运回来。温芷三天没合眼。
text.en: After the battle at Dingjun the wounded come back by the cartload. Wen Zhi hasn't closed her eyes in three days.

text.zh: 关羽在江陵练兵，伤了不少人。温芷三天没合眼。
text.en: Guan Yu's drills in Jiangling have injured a good many men. Wen Zhi hasn't closed her eyes in three days.

label.zh: 脱了外袍，帮她烧水、递药。
label.en: Take off your outer robe and help her: boil water, hand her medicines.

text.zh: 你笨手笨脚，碰翻了一回药罐。温芷没骂你，只是在天亮时靠着你的肩膀睡着了一会儿。
text.en: You're clumsy and knock over a medicine jar once. Wen Zhi doesn't scold you. Near dawn she falls asleep for a little while against your shoulder.

label.zh: 去找主将，从军中调几个人来帮她。
label.en: Go to the commander and get a few men assigned to help her.

text.zh: 第二天来了十个兵。温芷终于睡了一觉。醒来她说：『你总是这样，替我把事情安排好。』
text.en: Ten soldiers arrive the next day. Wen Zhi finally sleeps. When she wakes she says, 'You always do this—arrange things for me.'

text.zh: 黄忠去北山劫粮，过了约定的时辰还没回来。赵云带兵去接应，在乱军中救出了黄忠，一路杀回汉水边的营寨。曹操亲率大军追到寨前。你在寨里。
text.en: Huang Zhong has gone to raid the grain at the northern hill and is long overdue. Zhao Yun rides out to bring him back, cuts him free in the thick of the fighting, and fights his way back to the camp on the Han River. Cao Cao himself pursues with his main army to the camp's very gate. You are inside.

text.zh: 张翼要关寨门。赵云看着你。
text.en: Zhang Yi wants to shut the gates. Zhao Yun looks at you.

text.zh: 赵云在寨门口低声对你说：『桂阳那回，先生懂我。这回，也请先生懂我。』
text.en: At the gate Zhao Yun says quietly, 'At Guiyang you understood me. Understand me this time too.'

label.zh: 劝赵云：大开寨门，偃旗息鼓。曹操多疑，必不敢进。
label.en: Urge Zhao Yun: throw the gates open, lower the banners, silence the drums. Cao Cao is suspicious; he won't dare come in.

text.zh: 赵云一个人一杆枪立在寨门外。曹兵到了，看见寨门大开，不敢前进。一声梆子响，伏在壕里的弓弩齐发，曹兵自相践踏，退到汉水边，淹死无数。刘备第二天来看战场，说：『子龙一身都是胆也！』赵云说：『先生的主意。』
text.en: Zhao Yun stands alone outside the open gate with his spear. Cao's men arrive, see the gate wide open, and dare not advance. A clapper sounds; the crossbowmen hidden in the trench loose together, and Cao's men trample one another in the retreat to the Han River, where countless drown. Next day Liu Bei comes to see the field. 'Zilong is all courage!' Zhao Yun says, 'It was the master's idea.'

label.en: Urge Zhao Yun to shut the gates and hold.

text.zh: 寨门关了。曹兵攻了一夜，没有攻破，也伤了不少人。天亮时赵云说：『先生稳妥。』他嘴上这么说，你看得出他另有主意。
text.en: The gates close. Cao's men attack all night without breaking in, and plenty are hurt on both sides. At dawn Zhao Yun says, 'A safe choice, sir.' But you can tell he had a different idea.

label.zh: 什么也不说：子龙自有主张。
label.en: Say nothing: Zilong knows his own mind.

text.zh: 赵云大开寨门，单枪匹马立在门外。曹兵不敢前进，退的时候自相践踏。他回来时看了你一眼：『先生信我。』
text.en: Zhao Yun throws the gate open and stands alone outside it. Cao's men dare not advance, and trample one another in the retreat. Coming back in, he looks at you. 'You trusted me, sir.'

quote.zh: 寨门大开，二将不敢前进……玄德曰：“子龙一身都是胆也！”
quote.en: The camp gate stood wide open, and the two generals dared not advance. … Xuande said, "Zilong is all courage!"

text.zh: 黄忠被抬进寨里时还在笑：『定军山那回先生跟着我冲，这回换子龙了。』
text.en: Carried into the camp, Huang Zhong is still laughing. 'At Dingjun you charged with me, sir. This time it's Zilong's turn.'

text.zh: 汉水边的营里，黄忠的腿上缠着布，正在火边磨刀。他看见你，往旁边挪了挪。
text.en: In the camp by the Han River, Huang Zhong sits by the fire sharpening his blade, his leg bound in cloth. Seeing you, he shifts aside to make room.

text.zh: 他没抬头。你前些天的话，他还没消气。
text.en: He doesn't look up. He's still sore about what you said the other day.

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 黄忠送你走时说：『先生，老夫这条命，打完汉中，就交给主公了。』
text.en: As you leave, Huang Zhong says, 'Sir, once Hanzhong is won, this old life belongs to our lord.'

label.zh: 问他：七十岁了，还图什么？
label.en: Ask him: at seventy, what are you still fighting for?

text.zh: 黄忠想了很久：『图个名字。长沙城里的人都说我老了，我偏要让他们看看。』他摸着刀，『也图主公待我好。』
text.en: Huang Zhong thinks a long time. 'For my name. In Changsha they all said I was finished. I mean to show them.' He strokes his blade. 'And because our lord treats me well.'

label.zh: 说起关将军：他未必服你。
label.en: Bring up General Guan: he may not think much of you.

text.zh: 黄忠哼了一声：『长沙城下，他放过我一回。我欠他的。他服不服我，不要紧。』
text.en: Huang Zhong snorts. 'Under the walls of Changsha he spared me once. I owe him. Whether he rates me doesn't matter.'

label.en: Ask him to teach you to draw a bow.

text.zh: 黄忠哈哈大笑，把弓塞到你手里。你拉了三次，弓弦纹丝不动。他笑得眼泪都出来了：『先生还是拿笔吧！』
text.en: Huang Zhong roars with laughter and pushes his bow into your hands. Three times you pull, and the string doesn't budge. He laughs until he cries. 'Stick to the brush, sir!'

text.zh: 江陵城头，关羽一个人看着北边。樊城的方向，有几点灯火。他听见你的脚步：『睡不着？我也是。』
text.en: On the walls of Jiangling, Guan Yu stands alone looking north. Toward Fancheng there are a few points of light. He hears your step. 'Can't sleep? Nor can I.'

text.zh: 你想起几年前他说过的那句话：『所以我不能丢。』
text.en: You think of what he said years ago: 'That's why I can't lose it.'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 关羽送你下了城楼：『荆州有你，我放心些。』
text.en: Guan Yu walks you down from the wall. 'With you in Jingzhou, I rest a little easier.'

label.en: Ask him: you want to take Fancheng?

text.zh: 关羽没有否认：『大哥在汉中打得那么好。我在荆州，总不能一直守着。』
text.en: Guan Yu doesn't deny it. 'My brother is doing so well at Hanzhong. I can't just keep watch in Jingzhou forever.'

label.zh: 提醒他：北伐之前，先稳住东吴。
label.en: Warn him: before going north, make sure of Wu.

text.zh: 关羽皱眉：『军师也是这么说的。东和孙权，北拒曹操。』他沉默了一会儿，『这八个字，我记着。』
text.en: Guan Yu frowns. 'The strategist said the same. Ally with Sun Quan in the east, hold off Cao Cao in the north.' He is silent a moment. 'I remember those eight characters.'

label.en: Ask about his daughter.

text.zh: 关羽难得笑了：『像她娘，脾气倔。』他顿了顿，『将来要嫁人，也得嫁个配得上的。』
text.en: Guan Yu smiles, which is rare. 'Takes after her mother. Stubborn.' A pause. 'When she marries, it'll have to be someone worthy of her.'

label.en: Bring up Huarong.

text.zh: 『那一跪，』关羽说，『我还记着。』他给你斟满了酒。
text.en: 'You knelt,' Guan Yu says. 'I still remember.' He fills your cup.

text.zh: 『那一天你在道上求我，』关羽说，『我放了他。他如今是魏王了。』
text.en: 'That day on the road you begged me,' Guan Yu says, 'and I let him go. Now he's King of Wei.'

text.zh: 关羽摇摇头：『那件事，不提了。』
text.en: Guan Yu shakes his head. 'Let's not speak of that.'

text.zh: 关羽说：『陆口那天，你站在我身后。我知道。』
text.en: Guan Yu says, 'That day at Lukou, you stood behind me. I knew.'

text.zh: 关羽说：『那天席上你说得对。一个老卒罢了。』你没有接话。
text.en: Guan Yu says, 'You were right that night at the feast. Just an old soldier.' You don't answer.

text.zh: 关羽说：『那天席上你夸黄忠，我心里不痛快。可你没说错。』
text.en: Guan Yu says, 'When you praised Huang Zhong at the feast, I didn't like it. But you weren't wrong.'

text.zh: 探子回报：曹营昨夜的口令，是“鸡肋”两个字。接着又报：曹营里有人在收拾行装。刘备问众人这是什么意思。
text.en: Scouts report that last night's password in Cao's camp was two words: 'chicken rib.' Then another report: men in Cao's camp are packing their baggage. Liu Bei asks everyone what it means.

text.zh: 魏延在帐下，等着请战。
text.en: Wei Yan waits below the dais, ready to ask for battle.

text.zh: 魏延回来，在帐外对你说：『长沙那天先生替我说话。今天这一箭，算我还的。』
text.en: Back from the pursuit, Wei Yan says to you outside the tent, 'At Changsha you spoke for me, sir. Today's arrow is my repayment.'

text.zh: 你想起诸葛亮在长沙之后的安排：魏延每次出战，后面都多一支兵。今天也是。
text.en: You remember Zhuge Liang's rule after Changsha: whenever Wei Yan goes out, another column follows. Today too.

label.zh: 说：鸡肋者，食之无味，弃之可惜。曹操要退了，请派魏延追击。
label.en: Say: a chicken rib has no meat worth eating and is a pity to throw away. Cao Cao means to retreat. Send Wei Yan after him.

text.zh: 魏延领兵追到斜谷，一箭射中曹操的人中，折了两颗门牙。曹操退兵时，身后的火光一直烧到天亮。刘备说：『子衡这两个字，听得比曹操自己还明白。』
text.en: Wei Yan pursues to Xie Valley and puts an arrow into Cao Cao's face, knocking out two of his front teeth. As Cao withdraws, the fires behind him burn until dawn. Liu Bei says, 'Ziheng understood those two words better than Cao Cao did.'

label.zh: 说：曹操要退。可这两个字，会要了一个人的命。
label.en: Say: Cao Cao means to retreat. But these two words will cost a man his life.

text.zh: 众人面面相觑。几天后消息传来：曹操的主簿杨修，因为私下解说“鸡肋”，被曹操以惑乱军心的罪名斩了。诸葛亮看着你，什么也没说。
text.en: Everyone looks at one another. A few days later news arrives: Cao Cao's secretary, Yang Xiu, has been executed for spreading his reading of 'chicken rib' and so unsettling the army. Zhuge Liang looks at you and says nothing.

label.zh: 劝主公稳住：曹操诡计多端，不可轻追。
label.en: Urge your lord to stay put: Cao Cao is full of tricks; don't pursue rashly.

text.zh: 刘备点头。可魏延等不及，自己领兵追了出去，射落了曹操两颗门牙。回来后，他看你的眼神有点得意。
text.en: Liu Bei nods. But Wei Yan can't wait; he takes his own men in pursuit and shoots out two of Cao Cao's teeth. When he comes back, the look he gives you is a little smug.

quote.zh: 正沉吟间，夏侯惇入帐，禀请夜间口号。操随口曰：“鸡肋！鸡肋！”……修曰：“鸡肋者，食之无味，弃之可惜。”
quote.en: As he pondered, Xiahou Dun came in to ask for the night's password. Cao said without thinking, "Chicken rib! Chicken rib!" … Xiu said, "A chicken rib: there's no flavor in eating it, and it's a pity to throw it away."

text.zh: 糜芳请你喝酒。几杯下肚，他就开始抱怨：关将军从来看不起他，说他是靠着妹妹才有今天。
text.en: Mi Fang invites you for a drink. A few cups in, he starts complaining: General Guan has always looked down on him, says he only got where he is because of his sister.

text.zh: 他红着眼睛说：『我妹妹……是你在长坂坡救下来的。这些年，只有你把我当自己人。』
text.en: Red-eyed, he says, 'My sister… it was you who saved her at Changban. All these years, you're the only one who's treated me as one of us.'

text.zh: 他红着眼睛说：『我妹妹死在长坂坡那口井里。我们糜家把家产都给了主公，换来的是什么？』
text.en: Red-eyed, he says, 'My sister died in that well at Changban. We Mi gave our whole fortune to our lord, and what did we get for it?'

label.zh: 答应他：找机会在关将军面前替他说话。
label.en: Promise him you'll find a moment to speak for him to General Guan.

text.zh: 你找了个机会，跟关羽说糜芳守江陵有功。关羽淡淡地说：『他？』可那以后，关羽对糜芳说话，客气了一些。糜芳知道是你说的。
text.en: You find a moment to tell Guan Yu that Mi Fang has done good work holding Jiangling. Guan Yu says coolly, 'Him?' But after that he speaks to Mi Fang a little more civilly. Mi Fang knows it was you.

label.zh: 劝他收敛：这些话，在荆州不能说。
label.en: Tell him to watch himself: in Jingzhou, he can't say these things.

text.zh: 糜芳酒醒了一半，连连点头。可他看你的眼神，像是看一个关羽那边的人。
text.en: Mi Fang sobers up halfway and nods again and again. But the way he looks at you now, it's as if you're on Guan Yu's side.

label.zh: 回去把这番话告诉关羽。
label.en: Go back and tell Guan Yu what he said.

text.zh: 关羽听完，冷笑一声：『他也配有怨言？』第二天，他当众把糜芳骂了一顿。糜芳从帐里出来，看见了站在门口的你。
text.en: Guan Yu hears you out and laughs coldly. 'He's entitled to complain?' The next day he berates Mi Fang in front of everyone. Coming out of the tent, Mi Fang sees you standing by the door.

text.zh: 赵云托你替他写一封家书——他不识几个字，又不愿让别人知道。
text.en: Zhao Yun asks you to write a letter home for him—he can't write much and doesn't want anyone else to know.

label.en: Write it word for word as he says it.

text.zh: 信很短：『家中一切安好否？子龙在汉中，平安。』写完，赵云把信折好，揣进了怀里。他说：『这件事，先生别跟人说。』
text.en: The letter is short: 'Is all well at home? Zilong is at Hanzhong, and safe.' When it's done, Zhao Yun folds it and tucks it inside his armor. 'Don't tell anyone about this, sir.'

label.en: Teach him to write it himself.

text.zh: 赵云学得很慢，一封信写了三个晚上。写完，他看着自己的字笑了：『比枪难多了。』
text.en: Zhao Yun learns slowly; the letter takes three evenings. When it's done he looks at his own writing and smiles. 'Much harder than a spear.'

text.zh: 沔阳设坛，刘备即汉中王位。封赏完毕，诸葛亮把一份名单递给刘备：关羽、张飞、赵云、马超、黄忠，为五虎大将。刘备看了一遍，递给了你。
text.en: An altar is built at Mianyang and Liu Bei takes the throne as King of Hanzhong. When the honors have been handed out, Zhuge Liang gives Liu Bei a list: Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Ma Chao and Huang Zhong, the Five Tiger Generals. Liu Bei reads it and passes it to you.

text.zh: 你看见黄忠的名字时，想起了关羽。
text.en: When you see Huang Zhong's name, you think of Guan Yu.

text.zh: 刘禅被立为王世子。他在人群里认出了你——截江那天，抱着他的人是你。
text.en: Liu Shan is named Crown Prince. In the crowd he recognizes you: on the river that day, it was you who held him.

text.zh: 刘备看你的眼神有些淡。你说过的那些话，他还记着。
text.en: Liu Bei's eyes are a little cool when they rest on you. He still remembers some of the things you've said.

label.zh: 说：黄将军斩夏侯渊，当得起。
label.en: Say: General Huang killed Xiahou Yuan. He has earned it.

text.zh: 刘备点头，名单就这么定了。诸葛亮说：『云长那边，得派个会说话的人去。』
text.en: Liu Bei nods, and the list stands. Zhuge Liang says, 'We'll need to send someone with a gift for words to Yunchang.'

label.zh: 劝主公先写信问过关将军，再定名单。
label.en: Urge your lord to write to General Guan first, and settle the list after.

text.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停了：『子衡兄想得周到。可王位已定，名单拖着，旁人会怎么想？』刘备还是听了你的，名单暂不公布。黄忠什么也没说，只是那几天话少了。
text.en: Zhuge Liang's fan stops. 'Thoughtful of you, Ziheng. But the throne is already taken; if the list is held back, what will people think?' Liu Bei listens to you all the same, and the list is not announced. Huang Zhong says nothing, though for a few days he speaks less than usual.

label.zh: 自请和费诗同去荆州送印。
label.en: Ask to go to Jingzhou with Fei Shi to deliver the seal.

text.zh: 刘备看了你很久：『二弟最听你的。你去，我放心。』他把印绶亲手交给你。临行前，诸葛亮送到城门口：『子衡兄，荆州的事，多费心。』
text.en: Liu Bei looks at you a long time. 'My brother listens to you more than anyone. If you go, I can rest easy.' He hands you the seal and ribbon himself. As you set out, Zhuge Liang walks you to the gate. 'Ziheng, take good care of Jingzhou.'

text.zh: 黄忠看见你，在人群里冲你咧嘴一笑。
text.en: Huang Zhong spots you in the crowd and grins.

text.zh: 法正在你身边低声说：『定军山那面红旗，有你一半。』
text.en: Fa Zheng says quietly at your side, 'Half that red flag on Mount Dingjun was yours.'

text.zh: 赵云站在五虎将的位置上，朝你微微点了点头。
text.en: Standing in his place among the Five Tigers, Zhao Yun gives you the slightest nod.

text.zh: 魏延捂着腮帮子笑：『曹贼那两颗门牙，先生也有份。』
text.en: Wei Yan grins, a hand to his jaw. 'You had a share in those two teeth of Cao's, sir.'

text.zh: 有人说起杨修的死。诸葛亮朝你看了一眼。
text.en: Someone mentions Yang Xiu's death. Zhuge Liang glances your way.

q.zh: 大典之后，刘备拉着你走到坛下，低声问：『子衡，孤今日称王——你说，是对得起汉室，还是对不起？』
q.en: After the ceremony Liu Bei draws you down from the altar and asks quietly, 'Ziheng, today I took the title of king. Tell me—have I kept faith with the Han, or broken it?'

text.zh: 刘备的脸色变了，转身走回了坛上。
text.en: Liu Bei's face changes, and he turns and climbs back up to the altar.

answers.match: 野心|篡|伪|贼|想当皇帝|ambition|usurper|fake|wants the throne

means.zh: 说对得起：为了兴复汉室
means.en: says he has kept faith—to restore the Han

text.zh: 刘备握住你的手，很久才松开：『但愿如此。』
text.en: Liu Bei grips your hand and holds it a long time. 'Let's hope so.'

answers.match: 对得起|兴复|为了汉室|天下|名正言顺|kept faith|restore|the han|rightful

means.en: says some will say he broke it

text.zh: 刘备沉默了：『是。曹操也会这么说孤。』
text.en: Liu Bei is silent. 'Yes. Cao Cao will say so of me.'

answers.match: 有人会说|难说|未必|僭越|曹操|some will say|not sure|usurp

text.zh: 刘备拍了拍你的肩，没有再问。
text.en: Liu Bei pats your shoulder and doesn't ask again.

answers.match: 不知|不好说|can't say|don't know

text.zh: 费诗说了五虎将的名字。关羽的脸色一下子变了，把印推了回去。
text.en: Fei Shi names the Five Tigers. Guan Yu's face changes at once, and he pushes the seal back across the table.

text.zh: 费诗朝你看了一眼。他知道你在这里。
text.en: Fei Shi glances at you. He knows you're here.

label.zh: 帮费诗说话：萧何、曹参与高祖最亲，韩信是楚国的降将，却封王在他们之上。
label.en: Back Fei Shi up: Xiao He and Cao Can were closest to the Founder, and Han Xin was a general who came over from Chu—yet he was made a king above them.

text.zh: 关羽沉默了很久，站起来接过了印：『若不是你们两个，几误大事。』费诗走的时候，偷偷对你作了个揖。
text.en: Guan Yu is silent a long time, then stands and accepts the seal. 'If not for the two of you, I'd nearly have ruined things.' As Fei Shi leaves, he gives you a quiet bow.

label.zh: 先附和关羽，散了席再私下劝。
label.en: Agree with Guan Yu for now, and persuade him privately once the feast is over.

text.zh: 那天晚上你在关羽房里坐到三更。他终于叹了口气：『明天我就受印。』费诗等了一夜，第二天看见你，满眼血丝地笑了。
text.en: That night you sit in Guan Yu's room until the third watch. At last he sighs. 'I'll take the seal tomorrow.' Fei Shi has waited up all night; seeing you the next morning, he smiles through bloodshot eyes.

label.zh: 说：将军若不受，主公在汉中，怎么做人？
label.en: Say: if you won't accept, how will our lord in Hanzhong face anyone?

text.zh: 关羽的胡子抖了一下：『你拿大哥来压我？』他还是受了印，可从那以后，有好几天没跟你说话。
text.en: Guan Yu's beard trembles. 'You use my brother against me?' He accepts the seal, but for several days afterward he doesn't speak to you.

quote.zh: 云长怒曰：“翼德吾弟也；孟起世代名家；子龙久随吾兄，即吾弟也：位与吾相并，可也。黄忠何等人，敢与吾同列！大丈夫终不与老卒为伍！”遂不肯受印。
quote.en: Yunchang said angrily, "Yide is my brother; Mengqi is of a great family; Zilong has followed my brother so long he is my brother too: for them to stand level with me is fair. But what sort of man is Huang Zhong, to be ranked with me? A real man will never stand in line with an old soldier!" And he would not take the seal.

text.zh: 你想起那天席上说的“一个老卒罢了”。这句话，现在从关羽嘴里出来了。
text.en: You remember saying, at that feast, 'an old soldier, that's all.' Now the words are coming out of Guan Yu's mouth.

text.zh: 关羽瞥了你一眼：『你上回就替他说话。』
text.en: Guan Yu glances at you. 'You spoke for him last time too.'

text.zh: 温芷听说你要留在荆州，从成都赶来了，药箱还背在身上：『荆州要打仗了，那边缺大夫。』
text.en: Wen Zhi hears you're staying in Jingzhou and comes all the way from Chengdu, her medicine chest still on her back. 'There'll be fighting in Jingzhou. They need physicians.'

label.en: Keep her with you.

text.zh: 她把药箱放在你的住处。夜里她说：『这次，你走到哪里，我就到哪里。』
text.en: She sets her medicine chest down in your lodging. That night she says, 'This time, wherever you go, I go.'

label.en: Urge her to go back to Chengdu: Jingzhou is too dangerous.

text.zh: 温芷看了你很久，背起了药箱：『那你答应我，活着回来。』
text.en: Wen Zhi looks at you a long time, then shoulders her chest again. 'Then promise me you'll come back alive.'

text.zh: 温芷在城头给守夜的兵送药。你上去的时候，她正望着北边。
text.en: Wen Zhi is taking medicine up to the night watch on the walls. When you come up, she's looking north.

text.zh: 赤壁江边你说过的那句话，她一直没有回答过。也一直没有忘。
text.en: What you said to her by the river after Red Cliffs, she has never answered. Nor forgotten.

label.en: Stand with her a while.

text.zh: 她说：『关将军要北伐了，是不是？』你没说话。她把手放进你的手里。
text.en: She says, 'General Guan is going north, isn't he?' You don't answer. She puts her hand in yours.

text.zh: 她说：『汉中王了。你说，这一回，是不是快太平了？』你没说话。她把手放进你的手里。
text.en: She says, 'A king now. Do you think peace is close this time?' You don't answer. She puts her hand in yours.

label.zh: 跟她说实话：仗还要打很久。
label.en: Tell her the truth: the fighting will go on a long time.

text.zh: 温芷摇摇头：『伤兵在哪里，大夫就在哪里。』
text.en: Wen Zhi shakes her head. 'Where the wounded are, the physician is.'

text.zh: 诸葛瑾到了荆州，说孙权有个儿子，听说关将军有个女儿，愿结两家之好，并力破曹。关羽的脸沉了下来。
text.en: Zhuge Jin arrives in Jingzhou: Sun Quan has a son, he says, and has heard General Guan has a daughter; he would join the two houses and together break Cao Cao. Guan Yu's face darkens.

text.zh: 你刚从成都赶到，汉中王的嘱咐还在耳边。
text.en: You've only just arrived from Chengdu, the King of Hanzhong's instructions still in your ears.

text.zh: 诸葛瑾看见你，苦笑了一下：『又是你。』
text.en: Zhuge Jin sees you and smiles ruefully. 'You again.'

text.zh: 诸葛瑾提起湘水分界：『那三郡，关将军守约了。吴侯记着。』
text.en: Zhuge Jin mentions the Xiang River line. 'General Guan kept the agreement on the three commanderies. The Marquis remembers.'

text.zh: 诸葛瑾提起湘水分界：『少了江夏，吴侯到现在还不痛快。』
text.en: Zhuge Jin mentions the Xiang River line. 'Losing Jiangxia still rankles with the Marquis.'

text.zh: 关羽受印那天的事，他还没完全放下。你替主公压过他一回。
text.en: He hasn't quite let go of the day he took the seal. You leaned on him once in your lord's name.

label.zh: 抢在关羽开口之前：『小女年幼，将军还要问过汉中王。』
label.en: Speak before Guan Yu can: 'The girl is young; the general must first ask the King of Hanzhong.'

text.zh: 关羽瞪了你一眼，可那句骂人的话终究没有出口。诸葛瑾松了一口气，回去复命。孙权听了，只说：『关羽不肯。』没有动怒。
text.en: Guan Yu glares at you, but the insult he was about to hurl never leaves his mouth. Zhuge Jin breathes out and goes back to report. Sun Quan, hearing it, says only, 'Guan Yu won't.' He isn't enraged.

hint.zh: 需要关羽肯听你的：信任在「倚重」、交情在「交好」或看重在「推崇」以上
hint.en: Needs Guan Yu to listen to you: trust at Relied on, friendship at Close, or esteem at Admired or above

label.en: Don't intervene. Let him speak.

text.zh: 关羽勃然大怒，把诸葛瑾骂了出去。诸葛瑾回到江东，一五一十地说了。孙权大怒：『何太无礼耶！』当即召张昭等人，商议取荆州。
text.en: Guan Yu flies into a rage and drives Zhuge Jin out with curses. Back in the east, Zhuge Jin repeats every word. Sun Quan is furious—such insolence!—and at once summons Zhang Zhao and the others to plan the taking of Jingzhou.

label.zh: 由他骂。事后你连夜写信给诸葛瑾，替关将军赔礼。
label.en: Let him rage. Afterward, that same night, write to Zhuge Jin and apologize on the general's behalf.

text.zh: 诸葛瑾回信说：『子衡的心意，瑾收下了。可吴侯的脸，不是一封信能补的。』关羽后来知道了这封信，问你：『你替我赔什么礼？』
text.en: Zhuge Jin writes back: 'I accept your goodwill, Ziheng. But the Marquis's face can't be mended with a letter.' Guan Yu learns of the letter later and asks you, 'What were you apologizing for, on my behalf?'

quote.zh: 云长勃然大怒曰：“吾虎女安肯犬子乎！不看汝弟之面，力斩汝首！再休多言！”遂唤左右逐出。
quote.en: Yunchang flew into a rage: "Would my tigress take a dog for a husband? If not for your brother's sake I would have your head! Not another word!" And he had his men throw him out.

text.zh: 关羽对诸葛瑾说：『汉中王派来送印的人就在这里。有什么话，当着他说。』
text.en: Guan Yu tells Zhuge Jin, 'The man the King of Hanzhong sent with my seal is right here. Whatever you have to say, say it in front of him.'

text.zh: 诸葛瑾看见你，苦笑了一下：『成都那一趟，瑾记着。』
text.en: Zhuge Jin sees you and smiles ruefully. 'I remember that trip to Chengdu.'

text.zh: 关羽受了印，心情正好。可诸葛瑾一开口，他的脸色就变了。
text.en: Guan Yu has taken the seal and is in good spirits. But the moment Zhuge Jin opens his mouth, his face changes.

text.zh: 诸葛瑾说：『陆口那天站在关将军身后的，就是你吧。』
text.en: Zhuge Jin says, 'You were the one standing behind General Guan that day at Lukou, weren't you?'

text.zh: 诸葛瑾说：『子敬生前常提起你。』你这才知道，鲁肃已经不在了。
text.en: Zhuge Jin says, 'Zijing often spoke of you before he died.' Only then do you learn that Lu Su is gone.

text.zh: 糜芳在席末，看了你一眼，又低下头去。
text.en: Mi Fang, at the foot of the table, glances at you, then looks down again.

text.zh: 关羽给汉中王回了信：『汉升老当益壮，可与吾同列。』五虎将还是五个。只是这封信，来得比别人以为的晚了一个月。
text.en: Guan Yu writes back to the King of Hanzhong: 'Hansheng is as strong as ever in his old age; he may stand with me.' The Five Tigers are five after all. It's just that the letter arrives a month later than anyone expected.

q.zh: 诸葛瑾走后，关羽余怒未消，问你：『孙权那碧眼小儿，也配和关某结亲？你说！』
q.en: After Zhuge Jin has gone, Guan Yu is still fuming. 'That green-eyed brat Sun Quan—is he fit to join his house to mine? Tell me!'

means.en: warns that insulting the envoy will bring trouble

text.zh: 关羽看着你，过了很久才说：『你怕东吴？』
text.en: Guan Yu looks at you a long time. 'You're afraid of Wu?'

answers.match: 祸|危险|报复|偷袭|后方|麦城|trouble|danger|revenge|attack|behind

text.zh: 关羽哈哈大笑：『说得好！』
text.en: Guan Yu roars with laughter. 'Well said!'

answers.match: 不配|配不上|小儿|no\b|not worthy|never

means.zh: 说结亲是为了联吴抗曹
means.en: says the match would have held the alliance against Cao

text.zh: 关羽的笑容收了：『军师那八个字，我知道。』他没有再说下去。
text.en: Guan Yu's smile fades. 'I know the strategist's eight characters.' He says no more.

answers.match: 联吴|抗曹|盟|大局|东和|alliance|against cao|the bigger picture|ally

text.zh: 关羽冷哼一声，提刀出去了。
text.en: Guan Yu snorts, takes up his blade and walks out.

answers.match: 不知|不好说|can't say|don't know

text.zh: 关羽起兵攻樊城，命糜芳、傅士仁为先锋。出兵前夜，城中失火，烧了军器粮草。关羽大怒，要斩二人。
text.en: Guan Yu raises his army against Fancheng, with Mi Fang and Fu Shiren as vanguard. On the night before the march a fire breaks out in the city and burns weapons and grain. Guan Yu is enraged and means to behead them both.

text.zh: 糜芳跪在地上，回头看你。
text.en: Mi Fang, on his knees, looks back at you.

text.zh: 糜芳跪在地上，偷偷看了你一眼。你劝过他收敛，他到底没收敛住。
text.en: Mi Fang, on his knees, steals a glance at you. You told him to watch himself; he couldn't.

label.zh: 求关羽从轻：大战在即，先斩大将，不吉。
label.en: Beg Guan Yu for leniency: to behead generals on the eve of battle bodes ill.

text.zh: 关羽打了二人四十棍，夺了先锋印，让糜芳回南郡、傅士仁回公安守城。他说：『等我得胜回来，再与你们算账。』你知道这句话，他们会记很久。
text.en: Guan Yu has them each given forty strokes, strips them of the vanguard seal, and sends Mi Fang back to hold Nanjun and Fu Shiren to hold Gong'an. 'When I come back victorious,' he says, 'we'll settle this.' You know they'll remember those words for a long time.

label.en: Say nothing. Military law is military law.

text.zh: 费诗出来求情，关羽打了二人四十棍，赶回去守城。你看着糜芳一瘸一拐地走出辕门。
text.en: Fei Shi pleads for them; Guan Yu has them given forty strokes and sends them back to hold their cities. You watch Mi Fang limp out through the camp gate.

label.zh: 劝关羽：既然不用他们打仗，也别让他们守后方。
label.en: Urge Guan Yu: if they're not fit to fight, don't leave them guarding the rear either.

text.zh: 关羽想了想：『荆州还有谁可用？』你答不上来。最后，糜芳还是回了南郡，傅士仁还是回了公安。关羽说：『你这句话，我记着。』
text.en: Guan Yu thinks. 'Who else in Jingzhou is there?' You can't answer. In the end Mi Fang goes back to Nanjun and Fu Shiren to Gong'an all the same. Guan Yu says, 'I'll remember you said that.'

text.zh: 糜芳跪在地上，看都不看你一眼。
text.en: Mi Fang, on his knees, won't even look at you.

text.zh: 出兵前，关羽对你说：『东吴那门亲，你替我挡下了。也好，省得我说出难听的话。』
text.en: Before the march Guan Yu tells you, 'You turned that Wu match aside for me. Just as well—it saved me saying something ugly.'

text.zh: 关羽出兵前对你说：『你那封赔礼的信，以后别写了。』
text.en: Before the march Guan Yu tells you, 'That apology letter of yours—don't write another.'

means.zh: 求关羽饶糜芳、傅士仁一命
means.en: begs Guan Yu to spare Mi Fang and Fu Shiren

text.zh: 关羽的刀停在半空。他看了你很久，把刀插回鞘里：『看在子衡的面上，各打四十，留在后方。』糜芳磕头的时候，没有看关羽，只看你。
text.en: Guan Yu's blade stops in midair. He looks at you a long time, then sheathes it. 'For Ziheng's sake: forty strokes each, and they stay behind.' As Mi Fang knocks his head on the ground he doesn't look at Guan Yu—only at you.

moves.match: (饶|留|放).{0,6}(糜芳|傅士仁|他们|一命)|从轻|不吉|刀下留人|spare (them|mi fang)

text.zh: 消息一封接一封传到成都：关羽骂走了东吴的使者；关羽起兵攻打樊城；曹仁闭城不出。诸葛亮把战报看了很久，问你：『子衡兄，你怎么看？』
text.en: News reaches Chengdu dispatch after dispatch: Guan Yu has driven off Wu's envoy with insults; Guan Yu has marched on Fancheng; Cao Ren has shut himself inside the walls. Zhuge Liang studies the reports a long time and asks you, 'Ziheng, what do you make of it?'

label.zh: 劝主公派兵接应荆州：东吴不会坐视。
label.en: Urge your lord to send troops to back up Jingzhou: Wu won't sit idle.

text.zh: 刘备犹豫了：『二弟打得正顺……』诸葛亮却点了头，调了一支兵往上庸。你不知道这够不够。
text.en: Liu Bei hesitates. 'My brother is doing so well…' But Zhuge Liang nods, and a column is sent toward Shangyong. You don't know if it will be enough.

label.zh: 说：关将军威震华夏，不必担心。
label.en: Say: General Guan's name shakes the whole realm. There's no need to worry.

text.zh: 刘备笑了：『你也这么想。』诸葛亮没有笑。
text.en: Liu Bei smiles. 'So you think so too.' Zhuge Liang doesn't smile.

label.zh: 给关羽写信：北伐之前，先稳住东吴。
label.en: Write to Guan Yu: before going north, make sure of Wu.

text.zh: 你的信走了半个月。关羽的回信只有一句：『已知。』
text.en: Your letter takes half a month to arrive. Guan Yu's reply is a single line: 'Noted.'

text.zh: 你想起那份五虎将的名单。关羽的回信，终究还是来了。
text.en: You think of that list of the Five Tigers. Guan Yu's letter did come in the end.

text.zh: 黄忠来找你喝酒，说：『等荆州的仗打完，老夫去樊城给云长帮把手。』
text.en: Huang Zhong comes to drink with you. 'Once the fighting in Jingzhou is done, I'll go to Fancheng and give Yunchang a hand.'

text.zh: 关羽给汉中王回了信：『汉升老当益壮，可与吾同列。』五虎将还是五个。只是这封信，来得比别人以为的晚了一个月。
text.en: Guan Yu writes back to the King of Hanzhong: 'Hansheng is as strong as ever in his old age; he may stand with me.' The Five Tigers are five after all. It's just that the letter arrives a month later than anyone expected.

text.zh: 议事时，刘备已经很久没有问过你了。诸葛亮私下对你说：『子衡兄，主公心里有个结。』
text.en: It's been a long time since Liu Bei asked your opinion at council. Zhuge Liang tells you privately, 'Ziheng, our lord has a knot in his heart.'

label.en: Go to your lord and talk it through.

text.zh: 你们谈了一夜。天亮时，刘备说：『是我多心了。』
text.en: You talk all night. At dawn Liu Bei says, 'I've been too suspicious.'

hint.zh: 需要诸葛亮的看重在「器重」以上、赵云的信任在「可托」以上，或法正的看重在「器重」以上，才有人替你说一句话
hint.en: Needs Zhuge Liang's esteem at Valued or above, Zhao Yun's trust at Reliable or above, or Fa Zheng's esteem at Valued or above, for someone to put in a word for you

label.en: Wait. Do the work in front of you.

text.zh: 日子过得很慢。议事时，你的位子挪到了后排。
text.en: The days pass slowly. At council your seat has moved to the back row.

label.en: Take your leave.

text.zh: 刘备没有留你。
text.en: Liu Bei doesn't ask you to stay.

text.zh: 关羽已经好些天没叫你议事了。关平悄悄对你说：『父亲说，你的话太多。』
text.en: Guan Yu hasn't called you to council for days. Guan Ping tells you quietly, 'Father says you talk too much.'

label.zh: 去关羽府上，当面认个错。
label.en: Go to Guan Yu's residence and apologize to his face.

text.zh: 关羽让你在门外站了一个时辰，才叫你进去。他没提那些话，只是给你倒了一杯酒。
text.en: Guan Yu leaves you standing outside for an hour before calling you in. He doesn't mention what was said; he just pours you a cup of wine.

label.en: Wait for him to cool off.

text.zh: 一个月后，关羽在城头遇见你，点了点头。仅此而已。
text.en: A month later Guan Yu passes you on the wall and nods. That's all.

label.en: Ask to be transferred back to Chengdu.

text.zh: 关羽批了。你走的那天，他没有出来送。
text.en: Guan Yu approves it. The day you leave, he doesn't come out to see you off.

text.zh: 你说中的事情太多了。连东吴都有人在传：刘备手下有个能知未来的人。诸葛亮来找你：『子衡兄，亮不问你从哪里知道的。可曹操和孙权都会问。』
text.en: You've been right about too many things. Even in Wu people are saying Liu Bei has a man who knows the future. Zhuge Liang comes to you. 'I won't ask how you know, Ziheng. But Cao Cao and Sun Quan will.'

label.zh: 从此闭口：只说眼前的事。
label.en: Hold your tongue from now on: speak only of what's in front of you.

text.zh: 你很久没有再说过一句准话。人们慢慢忘了。
text.en: For a long time you say nothing that comes true. People slowly forget.

label.zh: 把实话告诉诸葛亮一个人。
label.en: Tell Zhuge Liang alone the truth.

text.zh: 诸葛亮听完，摇着扇子笑了很久：『原来如此。那亮以后，要多问问子衡兄了。』
text.en: Zhuge Liang hears you out and laughs a long while behind his fan. 'So that's it. Then I shall have to ask you more often.'

hint.zh: 需要诸葛亮的看重在「器重」以上
hint.en: Needs Zhuge Liang's esteem at Valued or above

label.en: Leave, so your lord isn't tainted by you.

text.zh: 你在一个雨夜出了城。
text.en: You leave the city one rainy night.

text.zh: 你说过的那些话，有人一句句抄了下来，送到了主公案头。
text.en: Someone has copied down the things you've said, line by line, and put them on your lord's desk.

label.en: Own it: you spoke out of turn.

text.zh: 主公没有罚你：『先生是聪明人，聪明人最该管住嘴。』
text.en: Your lord doesn't punish you. 'You're a clever man. Clever men should mind their tongues most of all.'

label.en: Argue: every word was true.

text.zh: 主公听完：『有些真话，要挑时候说。』
text.en: Your lord hears you out. 'Some truths need the right moment.'

text.zh: 关羽一掌拍在案上，酒杯跳了起来：『你再说一遍！』周仓已经按住了刀。
text.en: Guan Yu slams his palm on the table and the cups jump. 'Say that again!' Zhou Cang already has his hand on his blade.

label.en: Bow and apologize.

text.zh: 关羽哼了一声，挥手让你下去。
text.en: Guan Yu snorts and waves you away.

label.zh: 不退：『子衡说的，是为将军好。』
label.en: Don't back down: 'What I said, I said for your good, General.'

text.zh: 关羽盯着你看了很久，把手从案上收了回去：『下去吧。』第二天，他派人给你送了一坛酒。
text.en: Guan Yu stares at you a long time, then takes his hand off the table. 'Go.' The next day he sends you a jar of wine.

text.zh: 刘备慢慢放下手里的东西，看着你，很久没有说话。门外，张飞的影子停住了。刘备终于开口，声音很轻：『先生跟了备这些年。这句话，备想听你再说一遍——是醉话，还是真话？』
text.en: Liu Bei slowly sets down what he's holding and looks at you for a long time without a word. Outside the door, Zhang Fei's shadow stops. At last Liu Bei speaks, very quietly. 'You've followed me all these years, sir. I want to hear you say it once more—was that drink talking, or the truth?'

label.en: Kneel: it was drink talking—madness.

text.zh: 刘备扶你起来，拍了拍你的肩：『那就当没说过。』可从那天起，议事的时候，他不再先问你。
text.en: Liu Bei helps you up and pats your shoulder. 'Then it was never said.' But from that day on, in council, he no longer asks you first.

label.zh: 说：是真话——可我想杀的不是你，是那个寄人篱下、什么都不敢做的你。
label.en: Say: it was the truth—but what I want to kill isn't you, it's the you who lives under other men's roofs and dares nothing.

text.zh: 刘备愣住了。半晌，他笑了，眼眶却是红的：『先生这一刀，备受了。』
text.en: Liu Bei is stunned. After a long moment he laughs, though his eyes are red. 'I'll take that cut, sir.'

label.en: Say: it was the truth.

text.zh: 刘备点点头，没有叫张飞进来。他让人给你备了一匹马、一袋盘缠：『先生另择明主吧。备不送了。』那天夜里，你出了城。
text.en: Liu Bei nods and does not call Zhang Fei in. He has a horse and a purse of travel money made ready for you. 'Choose a better lord, sir. I won't see you off.' That night you leave the city.

text.zh: 你没有去成都。汉中的消息，是从集市上听来的。
text.en: You never went to Chengdu. You heard about Hanzhong in the market.

text.zh: 你在一个雨夜出了城。蜀中又多了一个关于妖人的故事。
text.en: You left the city one rainy night. Shu gained another story about a sorcerer.

text.zh: 你离开了。没有人留你，也没有人忘了你。
text.en: You left. No one asked you to stay. No one forgot you either.

text.zh: 关羽北攻樊城，你在中军帐里。身后的荆州，留给了糜芳和傅士仁。
text.en: Guan Yu marches on Fancheng, and you're in his headquarters tent. Behind you, Jingzhou is left to Mi Fang and Fu Shiren.

text.zh: 你留在成都。荆州的战报一封一封地来，你每一封都看两遍。
text.en: You stay in Chengdu. The reports from Jingzhou come one after another, and you read each one twice.

text.zh: 汉中王称王那天，第一个拉住的人是诸葛亮，第二个是你。
text.en: On the day he became king, the first person Liu Bei took by the hand was Zhuge Liang. The second was you.

text.zh: 汉中王遇事会问你。你说的，他大多会听。
text.en: The King of Hanzhong asks your opinion, and mostly takes it.

text.zh: 汉中王待你客气。你知道，客气就是隔着一层。
text.en: The King of Hanzhong is courteous to you. You know courtesy is a kind of distance.

text.zh: 孙权的亲事被婉拒了。东吴没有动怒——至少，没有当场动怒。
text.en: Sun Quan's proposal was declined gently. Wu didn't flare up—not on the spot, at least.

text.zh: 你替关羽赔了礼。诸葛瑾收下了信，孙权没有收下这口气。
text.en: You apologized for Guan Yu. Zhuge Jin accepted the letter. Sun Quan didn't accept the insult.

text.zh: 你劝过刘备派兵接应荆州。往上庸去的那支兵，走得不算快。
text.en: You urged Liu Bei to send troops to back up Jingzhou. The column toward Shangyong isn't moving fast.

text.zh: “一个老卒罢了。”这句话是你先说的，后来关羽说了很多遍。
text.en: 'An old soldier, that's all.' You said it first. Guan Yu said it many times after.

text.zh: 关羽说，荆州有你，他放心些。
text.en: Guan Yu said that with you in Jingzhou, he rested a little easier.

text.zh: 关羽骂走了东吴的使者，北上樊城。威震华夏，就在眼前。孙权在江东，也在等。
text.en: Guan Yu drove off Wu's envoy and marched north on Fancheng. Glory that would shake the realm was within reach. In the east, Sun Quan was waiting too.

text.zh: 关羽北上樊城。威震华夏，就在眼前。
text.en: Guan Yu marched north on Fancheng. Glory that would shake the realm was within reach.

text.zh: 黄忠逢人便说：定军山上，有个读书人跟着老夫一起冲下来的。
text.en: Huang Zhong tells everyone: on Mount Dingjun, a scholar charged down the hill right behind me.

text.zh: 法正说，定军山那面红旗，有你一半。
text.en: Fa Zheng says half that red flag on Mount Dingjun was yours.

text.zh: 黄忠说：先生懂我。
text.en: Huang Zhong says: the gentleman understands me.

text.zh: 定军山的事，你是在荆州听说的。
text.en: You heard about Mount Dingjun in Jingzhou.

text.zh: 黄忠斩了夏侯渊。蜀中的孩子都会学那一刀。
text.en: Huang Zhong killed Xiahou Yuan. Every child in Shu learned to mimic that stroke.

text.zh: 温芷跟着你去了荆州。她说：这次，你走到哪里，我就到哪里。
text.en: Wen Zhi went to Jingzhou with you. This time, she said, wherever you go, I go.

text.zh: 成都城西的小院里，温芷种的当归又开了花。
text.en: In the little yard on the west side of Chengdu, Wen Zhi's angelica has flowered again.

text.zh: 温芷在江陵城头给守夜的兵送药。北边的灯火，一夜比一夜多。
text.en: Wen Zhi carries medicine up to the night watch on the Jiangling walls. To the north, the lights grow more numerous each night.

text.zh: 温芷在成都开了一间医馆，穷人看病不收钱。
text.en: Wen Zhi runs a clinic in Chengdu. The poor pay nothing.

text.zh: 你很久没有温芷的消息了。
text.en: You haven't heard from Wen Zhi in a long time.

text.zh: 糜芳记得，荆州只有一个人在关羽面前替他说过话。
text.en: Mi Fang remembers that in all Jingzhou, only one man ever spoke for him to Guan Yu.

text.zh: 糜芳、傅士仁挨了四十棍，没有掉脑袋。他们会记得是谁求的情——也会记得那四十棍。
text.en: Mi Fang and Fu Shiren took forty strokes and kept their heads. They'll remember who pleaded for them—and the forty strokes.

text.zh: 糜芳从关羽帐里出来的时候，看见了站在门口的你。他不会忘。
text.en: When Mi Fang came out of Guan Yu's tent, he saw you standing by the door. He won't forget.

text.zh: 魏延射落了曹操两颗门牙，说那一箭是还你的。
text.en: Wei Yan shot out two of Cao Cao's teeth and said the arrow was his repayment to you.

text.zh: 赵云说：汉水边那扇门，是先生让开的。
text.en: Zhao Yun says: it was the gentleman who had that gate opened by the Han River.

text.zh: 杨修死了。你说过那两个字会要人命。
text.en: Yang Xiu is dead. You said those two words would cost a life.

text.zh: 法正的账本上，你的名字写在“恩”那一页。
text.en: In Fa Zheng's ledger, your name is on the page for kindnesses.

text.zh: 鲁肃死前，一直留着那张约。
text.en: Until he died, Lu Su kept that agreement.

text.zh: 庞统还活着，在汉中给法正出了不少主意，也跟他吵了不少架。
text.en: Pang Tong is still alive; at Hanzhong he gave Fa Zheng plenty of advice, and picked plenty of fights with him.

text.zh: 蜀中有人叫你先生，有人叫你妖人。
text.en: In Shu some call you Master; some call you sorcerer.

text.zh: 人说子衡口无遮拦。喜欢你的人说你真，怕你的人说你狂。
text.en: People say Ziheng can't hold his tongue. Those who like you call it honesty; those who fear you call it madness.

text.zh: 人说子衡重义。
text.en: People say Ziheng keeps faith.

text.zh: 人说子衡多智，也说子衡心深。
text.en: People say Ziheng is clever, and that his mind runs deep.

text.zh: 史书里没有你的传，只有几处『或曰』。
text.en: The histories give you no biography—just a few lines beginning 'some say.'

text.zh: 说书人讲到汉中和荆州，有好几处讲不顺——那几处，都是你。
text.en: When storytellers reach Hanzhong and Jingzhou, several places never quite fit. Those places are you.

text.zh: 三郡没有割。孙权北上合肥吃了亏，回头看荆州的眼神，一年比一年冷。
text.en: The commanderies were never ceded. Sun Quan was mauled at Hefei, and the way he looks at Jingzhou grows colder every year.

text.zh: 刘备称了汉中王，关羽北上樊城。刘家离天下，从来没有这么近过。
text.en: Liu Bei is King of Hanzhong, and Guan Yu marches on Fancheng. The house of Liu has never been so close to the realm.

garden.zh: 水墨淡彩，宽幅。许都后园，青梅枝从左上探入，远处城墙，右侧小亭中二人对坐煮酒，雷雨将至。图层：雷雨（闪电、雨丝）。
garden.en: Chinese ink wash with light color, wide banner. A walled garden in Xuchang: green-plum branches from the upper left, distant city wall, two men seated drinking in a small pavilion on the right, storm gathering. Layer: storm (lightning, rain).

lamp.zh: 夜，窗格内一灯如豆，一人跪坐读书，窗外竹影。图层：案上一道红色血诏。
lamp.en: Night. Through a lattice window a single lamp, a seated man reading, bamboo shadows outside. Layer: a red silk edict on the desk.

herbs.zh: 药圃，圆形月洞门，竹匾晒药，一名医女。图层：同行男子；春日落花；粉色花瓣（恋爱时刻）。
herbs.en: Herb garden with a round moon gate, bamboo drying trays, a woman physician. Layers: a man beside her; spring blossoms; pink petals (romance moment).

road.zh: 平原大路，行军队列与红旗，远处许都城墙。图层：远处尘土中的追骑。
road.en: A plain with a marching column and red banners, Xuchang's walls in the distance. Layer: pursuing riders in a dust cloud.

letter.zh: 夜，烛光书案，信笺、毛笔、砚台。图层：药包；朱印；窗外江面火光。
letter.en: Night desk by candlelight: letter, brush, inkstone. Layers: medicine packet; red seal; river glow through a window.

hill.zh: 土山被围，山顶一将与两位女眷，山下敌营红旗，一骑来劝降。图层：一骑从山后小路突围。
hill.en: A surrounded earthen hill: a general and two ladies on top, enemy tents with red flags below, a lone rider approaching to parley. Layer: a rider escaping down the back path.

hall.zh: 厅堂内景，梁柱，门外天光。图层：梁上悬印、贴封条的箱笼；一匹赤红骏马。
hall.en: Hall interior, beams and pillars, daylight through the door. Layers: an official seal hanging from a beam and sealed chests; a red warhorse.

camp.zh: 北方营寨，群山，蓝红旗帜林立。
camp.en: A northern army camp among mountains, forests of blue and red banners.

mirror.zh: 竹林溪畔，隐士抚琴，二客远立。
mirror.en: Bamboo grove by a stream, a recluse playing the zither, two visitors standing at a distance.

snow.zh: 雪中茅庐，篱笆，门外数人立雪等候。图层：第四人（徐庶）。
snow.en: A thatched cottage in snow with a fence, several men waiting outside. Layer: a fourth man (Xu Shu).

bridge.zh: 长坂桥，一将横矛立马桥上，桥东树林，百姓奔逃。图层：林中尘土（疑兵）；白袍骑将救人。
bridge.en: Changban bridge: a general with a spear on horseback on the bridge, woods to the east, fleeing civilians. Layers: dust in the woods (feint); a white-robed rider rescuing.

slope.zh: 山坡上曹操与旌旗，坡下枪阵，一白袍将怀抱婴儿突围。图层：阵边缺口中逃出的车辆。
slope.en: Cao Cao and banners on a hilltop, spear ranks below, a white-robed general breaking through with an infant. Layer: carts escaping through a gap.

fog.zh: 大雾江面，远岸营火。图层：插满箭的草船。
fog.en: Fog on the river, distant campfires. Layer: straw boats bristling with arrows.

fire.zh: 赤壁夜江，铁索连舟。图层：火攻与红天；火船；后营空/后营起火；提灯小舟（接人）；下游未连锁的船。
fire.en: Night river at Red Cliffs, ships chained together. Layers: fire and red sky; fire ships; rear camp empty or burning; a small boat with a lantern (rescue); unchained ships downstream.

huarong.zh: 华容道，两侧峭壁，泥泞小路，残兵队列，一将立马拦路。图层：背药箱的女子在队尾。
huarong.en: Huarong road between cliffs, a muddy path, a column of defeated soldiers, a general blocking the way on horseback. Layer: a woman with a medicine chest at the rear.

campfire.zh: 夜营篝火，帐篷剪影，二人对坐火边，火星飞起。图层：城楼（古城）；横在膝上的刀。
campfire.en: A night camp: a fire with sparks, tent silhouettes, two men seated by the fire. Layers: a city wall (Gucheng); a blade across the knees.

riverbank.zh: 战后夜江，水面漂着焦木，远处余火，江边一名女子洗药杵。图层：身旁一名男子。
riverbank.en: The river at night after battle: charred timbers drifting, distant embers, a woman washing a pestle at the water's edge. Layer: a man beside her.

ending.zh: 尾声：晨江远山，红日。图层：两人同舟；江边茅屋炊烟；城郭；独立江岸；梅枝；远帆。
ending.en: Epilogue: river and mountains at dawn, red sun. Layers: two people in a boat; a cottage with smoke; city walls; a lone figure on the shore; plum branch; distant sail.

citywall.zh: 水墨淡彩，宽幅。城墙与城门，城上旗帜。图层：攻城的长梯与枪林；刘字绿旗或东吴红旗；城门洞开；城下人群；黄昏。
citywall.en: Ink and wash, wide. A city wall and gate with banners. Layers: siege ladders and spears; Liu's green banners or Wu's red; open gate; crowd below; dusk.

temple.zh: 山寺，松树，亭台，主客数人。图层：廊下暗藏的刀斧手；被劈开的石头。
temple.en: Hillside temple, pines, pavilions, a few figures. Layers: axemen hidden in the corridor; a split rock.

bigriver.zh: 大江上一艘大船，船上女子与侍从。图层：小船上的武将；怀中孩子；横江拦截的船队与绿旗；东吴的红旗船。
bigriver.en: A large ship on the river, a woman and attendants aboard. Layers: a general on a small boat; a child; a blockade of boats with green banners; Wu's red-bannered ships.

mourning.zh: 夜，灵堂，白幡，灵位与烛火，一人跪拜。图层：两侧吊客；角落一个相貌古怪的人。
mourning.en: Night, a mourning hall, white banners, spirit tablet and candles, one figure kneeling. Layers: mourners on both sides; an odd-looking man in the corner.

ravine.zh: 竹林夹道的山间小路，一骑白马。图层：箭雨；倒地的随从；勒马回头。
ravine.en: A narrow hill path between bamboo, a rider on a white horse. Layers: a hail of arrows; a fallen companion; the rider turning back.

liubei.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，四十岁左右的汉室宗亲，面如冠玉，两耳垂肩，短须，小冠，青灰色交领长袍。表情：平静/温和/冷淡/忧伤/吃惊。
liubei.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: an imperial kinsman around forty, fair face, very long earlobes, short beard, small crown, grey-green crossed-collar robe. Expressions: neutral / warm / cold / sad / surprised.

guanyu.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，面如重枣，丹凤眼，卧蚕眉，长髯过胸，绿头巾，绿袍。表情同上。
guanyu.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: face the deep red of a jujube, phoenix eyes, thick 'silkworm' brows, a beard past the chest, green headscarf and green robe. Same expressions.

caocao.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，丞相，细眼，长须，高冠，深红黑色官袍。表情同上。
caocao.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: the Chancellor, narrow eyes, long thin beard, tall official hat, dark red-black robe. Same expressions.

zhuge.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，二十七岁，纶巾，白色鹤氅，手持羽扇，神情从容。表情同上。
zhuge.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: twenty-seven, silk scholar's cap, white crane-feather cloak, feather fan, composed. Same expressions.

wenzhi.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，原创人物：成年女医者，高髻，金簪，一朵梅花，浅蓝灰衣裙。表情同上，另加害羞。
wenzhi.en: Ink-wash bust portrait, original character: an adult woman physician, high bun, gold hairpin, a plum blossom, pale blue-grey dress. Same expressions plus shy.

zhouyu.zh: 东吴大都督，三十出头，面容俊秀，戴小冠，红色袍服；神情自负。表情：平静、微笑、冷淡、哀伤、吃惊、羞赧。
zhouyu.en: Grand Commander of Wu, early thirties, handsome, small cap, red robes, proud bearing. Moods: neutral, warm, cold, sad, surprised, shy.

lusu.zh: 东吴重臣，中年，短须，忠厚，赭色袍服。
lusu.en: Senior minister of Wu, middle-aged, short beard, honest face, ochre robes.

zhaoyun.zh: 身长八尺，浓眉大眼，阔面重颐（第7回）；银白盔甲，盔顶白缨。
zhaoyun.en: Eight feet tall, thick brows, large eyes, broad face and full jaw (ch. 7); silver-white armour, white plume.

sunfuren.zh: 孙权之妹，成年女子，发髻插金簪红花，红色衣裳，神情刚烈。
sunfuren.en: Sun Quan's sister, an adult woman, hair in a bun with a gold pin and red flowers, red clothes, fierce expression.

pangtong.zh: 浓眉掀鼻，黑面短髯，形容古怪（第57回）；褐色头巾。
pangtong.en: Thick brows, upturned nose, dark face, short beard, odd-looking (ch. 57); brown head scarf.

zhangsong.zh: 额镢头尖，鼻偃齿露，身短不满五尺（第60回）；尖顶小帽。
zhangsong.en: Pointed head, flat nose, protruding teeth, under five feet tall (ch. 60); small pointed cap.

fazheng.zh: 四十岁上下的谋士，面容清瘦，目光锐利，留短须，黑色纶巾，深青色袍服；神情冷静，似笑非笑。
fazheng.en: A strategist around forty, lean face, sharp eyes, short beard, black silk cap, dark teal robes; calm, a half smile.

huangzhong.zh: 年近七十的老将，白发白须，精神矍铄，身材魁梧，金色铠甲，背负大弓，手持大刀；笑容豪爽。
huangzhong.en: A general nearly seventy, white hair and beard, vigorous and broad-shouldered, golden armour, a great bow on his back and a broadsword; a hearty grin.

kept_text.en: You kept your word to Wen Zhi. She says nothing—only holds your hand very tightly.

broken_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，被你自己拿去换了军报。她再提起这句话时，语气平得像在念药方。
broken_text.en: The promise you made Wen Zhi, you traded for military intelligence. When she mentions it again, her voice is as flat as a prescription.

broken_text.en: The promise you made Wen Zhi, you traded for military intelligence. When she mentions it again, her voice is as flat as a prescription.

kept_text.zh: 你对刘备说过不离不弃。一卷走完，你还在他身边。
kept_text.en: You told Liu Bei you'd never leave him. At the end of the volume, you're still at his side.

broken_text.zh: 你对刘备说过不离不弃。后来古城的消息传来，说他听说你留在了曹营，只说了一句：『人各有志。』
broken_text.en: You told Liu Bei you'd never leave him. Word reaches you that when he heard you'd stayed with Cao, he said only: 'Every man chooses his own road.'

kept_text.zh: 你对关羽许过的话，你守住了。在他那里，这比什么都重。
kept_text.en: You kept the word you gave Guan Yu. To him, nothing weighs more.

broken_text.zh: 你对关羽许过的话，没有守住。他再也不跟你喝酒了。
broken_text.en: You broke the word you gave Guan Yu. He never drinks with you again.

kept_text.zh: 你对曹操说过要尽忠。至少到这一卷为止，你做到了。
kept_text.en: You told Cao Cao you'd serve him faithfully. For this volume at least, you did.

broken_text.zh: 你对曹操说过要尽忠，却在长坂坡放走了刘备的家眷。他不知道。你知道。
broken_text.en: You swore loyalty to Cao Cao, then let Liu Bei's people go at Changban. He doesn't know. You do.

desc.zh: 你跟着刘备入了川。益州到手那天，你留在了他身边。
desc.en: You followed Liu Bei into the west. The day Yi province was won, you stayed at his side.

desc.zh: 益州到手后，你请命回了荆州。关羽说，有你在旁边，他放心些。
desc.en: Once Yi province was won, you asked to go back to Jingzhou. Guan Yu said that with you beside him he rested easier.

desc.zh: 温芷一直在你身边，从赤壁的火到西川的路。
desc.en: Wen Zhi has been at your side all along, from the fire at Red Cliffs to the roads of the west.

desc.zh: 落凤坡的事，你说中了。有人叫你先生，有人叫你妖人。
desc.en: You called Fallen Phoenix Slope before it happened. Some call you Master; some call you a sorcerer.

desc.zh: 你早早就离开了。荆州和西川的事，你是从远处听说的。
desc.en: You left early. You heard about Jingzhou and the west from far away.
